File: backend/src/work-orders/work-order-scope.ts
================
import { Prisma, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';

/**
 * Órdenes visibles para el usuario autenticado:
 *  - GERENTE: todas.
 *  - MECANICO: solo las asignadas a él.
 *  - CLIENTE: solo las de sus vehículos.
 * Combinar siempre con el filtro propio de la consulta (`{ id, ...scope }`).
 */
export function workOrderScope(user: AuthenticatedUser): Prisma.WorkOrderWhereInput {
  switch (user.role) {
    case Role.GERENTE:
      return {};
    case Role.MECANICO:
      return { mechanicId: user.id };
    case Role.CLIENTE:
      return { vehicle: { ownerId: user.id } };
    default:
      throw new ForbiddenException('Este rol no puede acceder a órdenes de trabajo');
  }
}

File: frontend/src/api/crud.ts

import api from './axios';

/**
 * Cliente CRUD genérico para los recursos REST del backend.
 * El backend actualiza con PATCH (no PUT): `update` envía solo los campos modificados.
 */
export interface CrudApi<TEntity, TCreate, TUpdate> {
  list: () => Promise<TEntity[]>;
  get: (id: number) => Promise<TEntity>;
  create: (payload: TCreate) => Promise<TEntity>;
  update: (id: number, payload: TUpdate) => Promise<TEntity>;
  remove: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
}

/** @param resource Ruta relativa a /api, por ejemplo `/users`. */
export function createCrudApi<TEntity, TCreate, TUpdate = Partial<TCreate>>(
  resource: string,
): CrudApi<TEntity, TCreate, TUpdate> {
  return {
    list: async () => (await api.get<TEntity[]>(resource)).data,
    get: async (id) => (await api.get<TEntity>(`${resource}/${id}`)).data,
    create: async (payload) => (await api.post<TEntity>(resource, payload)).data,
    update: async (id, payload) =>
      (await api.patch<TEntity>(`${resource}/${id}`, payload)).data,
    remove: async (id) => {
      await api.delete(`${resource}/${id}`);
    },
  };
}

================
File: frontend/src/api/socket.ts
================
import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

const SOCKET_URL = (import.meta.env.VITE_SOCKET_URL || 'http://localhost:3000').replace(/\/+$/, '');

/**
 * Conexión Socket.io al gateway de hardware (LEDs), apta para ngrok.
 *
 * - `transports: ['websocket']`: sin long-polling. Las peticiones XHR del
 *   polling pasan por la página de advertencia de ngrok y rompen el handshake.
 * - Sin `extraHeaders`: el navegador NO permite headers propios en el
 *   handshake WebSocket (solo se enviaban en polling), por eso no se usan.
 * - Reconexión con backoff acotado para sobrevivir reinicios del túnel o de la Pi.
 *
 * Quien la crea debe llamar a `socket.disconnect()` al desmontar.
 */
export function createHardwareSocket(): Socket {
  return io(SOCKET_URL, {
    transports: ['websocket'],
    reconnection: true,
    reconnectionDelay: 1000,
    reconnectionDelayMax: 10000,
    timeout: 10000,
  });
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/ResourceFormModal.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Loader2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';

export type FormValues = Record<string, string | boolean>;

export interface SelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
}

export interface FormField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  type: 'text' | 'email' | 'password' | 'number' | 'textarea' | 'select' | 'datetime' | 'checkbox';
  required?: boolean;
  placeholder?: string;
  help?: string;
  /** Opciones fijas de un select. */
  options?: SelectOption[];
  /** Opciones asíncronas de un select (se cargan al abrir el modal). */
  loadOptions?: () => Promise<SelectOption[]>;
  min?: number;
  step?: string;
  maxLength?: number;
  /** Ocupa las dos columnas en pantallas anchas. */
  wide?: boolean;
}

interface ResourceFormModalProps {
  title: string;
  submitLabel: string;
  fields: FormField[];
  initialValues: FormValues;
  /** Debe lanzar en error; el modal muestra el mensaje del backend y queda abierto. */
  onSubmit: (values: FormValues) => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const fieldClass =
  'w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white disabled:opacity-50 glass-input';

/** Modal de alta/edición configurable por campos (glass, slate + brand). */
export default function ResourceFormModal({
  title,
  submitLabel,
  fields,
  initialValues,
  onSubmit,
  onClose,
}: ResourceFormModalProps) {
  const [values, setValues] = useState<FormValues>(initialValues);
  const [asyncOptions, setAsyncOptions] = useState<Record<string, SelectOption[]>>({});
  const [isLoadingOptions, setIsLoadingOptions] = useState(fields.some((field) => field.loadOptions));
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loaders = fields.flatMap((field) =>
      field.loadOptions ? [{ name: field.name, load: field.loadOptions }] : [],
    );
    if (loaders.length === 0) return;
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const loaded = await Promise.all(
          loaders.map(async ({ name, load }) => [name, await load()] as const),
        );
        if (active) setAsyncOptions(Object.fromEntries(loaded));
      } catch (error) {
        if (active) toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudieron cargar las opciones del formulario.'));
      } finally {
        if (active) setIsLoadingOptions(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
    // Solo al montar: los campos se fijan al abrir el modal y no cambian mientras está abierto.
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !isSaving) onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [isSaving, onClose]);

  const setValue = (name: string, value: string | boolean) =>
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [name]: value }));

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const missing = fields.find(
      (field) => field.required && field.type !== 'checkbox' && String(values[field.name] ?? '').trim() === '',
    );
    if (missing) {
      toast.error(`Completa el campo "${missing.label}".`);
      return;
    }
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit(values);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo guardar.'));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const renderField = (field: FormField, autoFocus: boolean) => {
    const value = values[field.name];
    const common = { id: `field-${field.name}`, name: field.name, autoFocus, disabled: isSaving };

    switch (field.type) {
      case 'checkbox':
        return (
          <label className="flex items-center gap-3 text-sm text-slate-300">
            <input
              {...common}
              type="checkbox"
              checked={value === true}
              onChange={(event) => setValue(field.name, event.target.checked)}
              className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-orange-500 glass-input"
            />
            {field.label}
          </label>
        );
      case 'textarea':
        return (
          <textarea
            {...common}
            rows={3}
            maxLength={field.maxLength}
            value={String(value ?? '')}
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            onChange={(event) => setValue(field.name, event.target.value)}
            className={fieldClass}
          />
        );
      case 'select': {
        const options = field.options ?? asyncOptions[field.name] ?? [];
        const loading = Boolean(field.loadOptions) && isLoadingOptions;
        return (
          <select
            {...common}
            disabled={isSaving || loading}
            value={String(value ?? '')}
            onChange={(event) => setValue(field.name, event.target.value)}
            className={fieldClass}
          >
            <option value="">{loading ? 'Cargando…' : field.placeholder ?? 'Selecciona una opción'}</option>
            {options.map((option) => (
              <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
                {option.label}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        );
      }
      default:
        return (
          <input
            {...common}
            type={field.type === 'datetime' ? 'datetime-local' : field.type}
            min={field.min}
            step={field.step}
            maxLength={field.maxLength}
            inputMode={field.type === 'number' ? 'decimal' : undefined}
            value={String(value ?? '')}
            placeholder={field.placeholder}
            onChange={(event) => setValue(field.name, event.target.value)}
            className={fieldClass}
          />
        );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 glass-overlay"
      onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && !isSaving && onClose()}
    >
      <form
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="resource-form-title"
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="glass-strong flex max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-2xl flex-col rounded-2xl shadow-2xl"
      >
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-white/10 p-5">
          <h3 id="resource-form-title" className="text-lg font-bold text-white">{title}</h3>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar" className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="grid gap-4 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          {fields.map((field, index) => (
            <div key={field.name} className={field.wide || field.type === 'textarea' ? 'sm:col-span-2' : ''}>
              {field.type !== 'checkbox' && (
                <label htmlFor={`field-${field.name}`} className="mb-1.5 block text-sm text-slate-300">
                  {field.label}
                  {field.required && <span className="text-brand-400"> *</span>}
                </label>
              )}
              {renderField(field, index === 0)}
              {field.help && <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{field.help}</p>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        <footer className="flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-white/10 p-5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSaving}
            className="rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 btn-secondary"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSaving || isLoadingOptions}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50 btn-primary"
          >
            {isSaving && <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />}
            {submitLabel}
          </button>
        </footer>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/RoleProtectedRoute.tsx

import { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

interface RoleProtectedRouteProps {
  allowedRoles: Role[];
  children: ReactNode;
}

export default function RoleProtectedRoute({
  allowedRoles,
  children,
}: RoleProtectedRouteProps) {
  const { user } = useAuth();

  if (!user || !allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
}

================
File: frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx
================
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react';
import api from '../api/axios';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';

export type Role = 'GERENTE' | 'MECANICO' | 'BODEGUERO' | 'CONTADOR' | 'CLIENTE' | 'PROVEEDOR';

export interface User {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
}

interface AuthContextType {
  user: User | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isLoading: boolean;
  login: (token: string, user: User) => void;
  logout: () => void;
}

const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const AuthProvider: React.FC<{ children: ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    // Restaurar sesión desde localStorage
    const initAuth = async () => {
      const token = localStorage.getItem('geartrace_token');
      if (token) {
        try {
          // Validar el token contra el backend
          const response = await api.get('/auth/me');
          setUser(response.data.user);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Token inválido o expirado");
          localStorage.removeItem('geartrace_token');
        }
      }
      setIsLoading(false);
    };

    initAuth();

    // Escuchar evento de interceptor de axios
    const handleUnauthorized = () => {
      setUser(null);
      navigate('/login');
    };
    window.addEventListener('auth:unauthorized', handleUnauthorized);

    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth:unauthorized', handleUnauthorized);
  }, [navigate]);

  const login = (token: string, userData: User) => {
    localStorage.setItem('geartrace_token', token);
    setUser(userData);
    navigate('/dashboard');
  };

  const logout = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem('geartrace_token');
    setUser(null);
    navigate('/login');
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, isAuthenticated: !!user, isLoading, login, logout }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

File: frontend/src/utils/format.ts

const CURRENCY = 'USD';

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es', { dateStyle: 'medium' });
const dateTimeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es', {
  dateStyle: 'medium',
  timeStyle: 'short',
});
const currencyFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('es', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: CURRENCY,
});

export const EMPTY = '—';

export function formatDate(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return value ? dateFormatter.format(new Date(value)) : EMPTY;
}

export function formatDateTime(value: string | null | undefined): string {
  return value ? dateTimeFormatter.format(new Date(value)) : EMPTY;
}

/** Los Decimal de Prisma llegan como string. */
export function formatCurrency(value: string | number | null | undefined): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return EMPTY;
  return currencyFormatter.format(Number(value));
}

================
File: frontend/src/utils/formValues.ts
================
import { UserInputError } from '../api/errors';
import type { FormValues, SelectOption } from '../components/ui/ResourceFormModal';

/** Texto recortado; '' si no hay valor. */
export function text(values: FormValues, name: string): string {
  const value = values[name];
  return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
}

/** Texto opcional: `undefined` si está vacío (no se envía al backend). */
export function optionalText(values: FormValues, name: string): string | undefined {
  return text(values, name) || undefined;
}

/** Número opcional: `undefined` si está vacío. Lanza si no es un número válido. */
export function optionalNumber(values: FormValues, name: string, label: string): number | undefined {
  const raw = text(values, name);
  if (raw === '') return undefined;
  const parsed = Number(raw);
  if (Number.isNaN(parsed)) throw new UserInputError(`"${label}" debe ser un número.`);
  return parsed;
}

/** Número obligatorio. Lanza si falta o no es válido. */
export function requiredNumber(values: FormValues, name: string, label: string): number {
  const parsed = optionalNumber(values, name, label);
  if (parsed === undefined) throw new UserInputError(`Completa el campo "${label}".`);
  return parsed;
}

/** ISO → valor de <input type="datetime-local"> en hora local. */
export function toDateTimeLocal(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  if (!iso) return '';
  const date = new Date(iso);
  const offset = date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000;
  return new Date(date.getTime() - offset).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

/** Valor de <input type="datetime-local"> (hora local) → ISO UTC. */
export function fromDateTimeLocal(value: string): string {
  return new Date(value).toISOString();
}

/** Valor para un select a partir de un id numérico opcional. */
export function idValue(id: number | null | undefined): string {
  return id === null || id === undefined ? '' : String(id);
}

/** Convierte una lista a opciones de select. */
export function toOptions<T>(items: T[], value: (item: T) => number, label: (item: T) => string): SelectOption[] {
  return items.map((item) => ({ value: String(value(item)), label: label(item) }));
}

File: github/copilot-instructions.md
================
# GearTrace - Reglas de Monorepo

## Estructura General
- `/backend`: API REST, WebSockets e IoT construidos con NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL.
- `/frontend`: Dashboard en tiempo real construido con React + Vite + TailwindCSS.

## Reglas Globales
1. No cruzar código de backend en archivos del frontend ni viceversa, solo hacerlo si se refactoriza codigo de una funcion especifica.
2. Mantener la arquitectura modular (Backend desacoplado del Frontend).
3. Toda comunicación entre ambos se realiza exclusivamente vía API REST (`/api/...`) o Socket.io (`led:activated`, etc.).

  postgres:
    image: postgres:15-alpine
    container_name: geartrace_postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-geartrace}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-geartrace_secret}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-geartrace_db}
    ports:
      - '${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}:5432'
    volumes:
      - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER:-geartrace} -d ${POSTGRES_DB:-geartrace_db}']
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - geartrace_network

  # Servicio opcional: pgAdmin para gestión visual de la BD
  pgadmin:
    image: dpage/pgadmin4:latest
    container_name: geartrace_pgadmin
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL: ${PGADMIN_EMAIL:-admin@geartrace.local}
      PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: ${PGADMIN_PASSWORD:-admin}
      PGADMIN_CONFIG_SERVER_MODE: 'False'
    ports:
      - '${PGADMIN_PORT:-5050}:80'
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - geartrace_network
    profiles:
      - tools # Solo se levanta con: docker compose --profile tools up

volumes:
  postgres_data:
    driver: local

networks:
  geartrace_network:
    driver: bridge

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigModule } from '@nestjs/config';
import { InventoryModule } from '../inventory/inventory.module';
import { LedModule } from '../led/led.module';
import { alexaConfig } from './alexa.config';
import { AlexaController } from './alexa.controller';
import { AlexaService } from './alexa.service';
import { ALEXA_INTENT_HANDLERS, AlexaIntentHandler } from './intents/alexa-intent-handler';
import { HelpIntentHandler, StopIntentHandler } from './intents/built-in.handlers';
import { FindPartIntentHandler } from './intents/find-part.handler';
import { ListBoxesIntentHandler } from './intents/list-boxes.handler';
import { LowStockIntentHandler } from './intents/low-stock.handler';

/** Registro de intents: agregar aquí cada handler nuevo. */
const INTENT_HANDLERS = [
  FindPartIntentHandler,
  ListBoxesIntentHandler,
  LowStockIntentHandler,
  HelpIntentHandler,
  StopIntentHandler,
];

@Module({
  imports: [
    ConfigModule.forFeature(alexaConfig),
    InventoryModule, // datos de piezas y cajas
    LedModule, // puerto LOCATION_INDICATOR (dependencia en un solo sentido)
  ],
  controllers: [AlexaController],
  providers: [
    ...INTENT_HANDLERS,
    {
      provide: ALEXA_INTENT_HANDLERS,
      inject: INTENT_HANDLERS,
      useFactory: (...handlers: AlexaIntentHandler[]) => handlers,
    },
    AlexaService,
  ],
  exports: [AlexaService],
})
export class AlexaModule {}

import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  UseGuards,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { CurrentUser, Roles } from '../auth/decorators/auth.decorators';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from '../auth/guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard';
import { CreateWorkOrderFromAppointmentDto } from '../work-orders/dto/work-order.dto';
import { WorkOrdersService } from '../work-orders/work-orders.service';
import { AppointmentsService } from './appointments.service';
import { CreateAppointmentDto, UpdateAppointmentDto } from './dto/appointment.dto';

/**
 * /api/appointments — Agenda del taller (personal).
 * El CLIENTE agenda sus propias citas en POST /api/client/appointments.
 */
@Controller('appointments')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.GERENTE, Role.MECANICO)
export class AppointmentsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly appointmentsService: AppointmentsService,
    private readonly workOrdersService: WorkOrdersService,
  ) {}

  @Get()
  findAll() {
    return this.appointmentsService.findAll();
  }

  @Get(':id(\\d+)')
  findOne(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.appointmentsService.findOne(id);
  }

  @Post()
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  create(@Body() dto: CreateAppointmentDto) {
    return this.appointmentsService.create(dto);
  }

  /** Cita → OT: crea la orden de trabajo desde la cita y la marca COMPLETADA. */
  @Post(':id(\\d+)/work-order')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  createWorkOrder(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: CreateWorkOrderFromAppointmentDto,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    return this.workOrdersService.createFromAppointment(id, dto, user);
  }

  @Patch(':id(\\d+)')
  update(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateAppointmentDto,
  ) {
    return this.appointmentsService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id(\\d+)')
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  remove(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.appointmentsService.remove(id);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/appointments/appointments.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AppointmentStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateAppointmentDto, UpdateAppointmentDto } from './dto/appointment.dto';

const APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE = {
  vehicle: {
    include: { owner: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } },
  },
  workOrder: { select: { id: true, number: true, status: true } },
} as const;

const FINAL_STATUSES: AppointmentStatus[] = [
  AppointmentStatus.COMPLETADA,
  AppointmentStatus.CANCELADA,
];

@Injectable()
export class AppointmentsService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.appointment.findMany({
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { scheduledAt: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const appointment = await this.prisma.appointment.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
    });
    if (!appointment) throw new NotFoundException(`Cita con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return appointment;
  }

  async create(dto: CreateAppointmentDto) {
    await this.ensureVehicle(dto.vehicleId);
    return this.prisma.appointment.create({
      data: {
        scheduledAt: this.toFutureDate(dto.scheduledAt),
        reason: dto.reason,
        vehicleId: dto.vehicleId,
      },
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateAppointmentDto) {
    const appointment = await this.findOne(id);
    if (FINAL_STATUSES.includes(appointment.status)) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una cita completada o cancelada no puede modificarse');
    }
    if (dto.vehicleId !== undefined) await this.ensureVehicle(dto.vehicleId);

    return this.prisma.appointment.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        ...dto,
        scheduledAt: dto.scheduledAt ? this.toFutureDate(dto.scheduledAt) : undefined,
      },
      include: APPOINTMENT_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    await this.findOne(id);
    await this.prisma.appointment.delete({ where: { id } });
  }

  private toFutureDate(value: string): Date {
    const date = new Date(value);
    if (date <= new Date()) {
      throw new BadRequestException('La cita debe agendarse para una fecha futura');
    }
    return date;
  }

  private async ensureVehicle(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.vehicle.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts
================
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { PassportStrategy } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ExtractJwt, Strategy } from 'passport-jwt';
import { ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { PrismaService } from '../../prisma/prisma.service';
import { JwtPayload, AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth.types';
import { UnauthorizedException } from '@nestjs/common';

/**
 * JwtStrategy
 *
 * Passport strategy para validar JWT en cada request.
 * El JWT se extrae del header: Authorization: Bearer <token>
 *
 * validate() se llama automáticamente en cada request protegido.
 * El valor retornado se asigna a req.user.
 */
@Injectable()
export class JwtStrategy extends PassportStrategy(Strategy) {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(JwtStrategy.name);

  constructor(
    private readonly config: ConfigService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {
    super({
      jwtFromRequest: ExtractJwt.fromAuthHeaderAsBearerToken(),
      ignoreExpiration: false,
      secretOrKey: config.getOrThrow<string>('JWT_SECRET'),
    });
  }

  async validate(payload: JwtPayload): Promise<AuthenticatedUser> {
    // Verificar que el usuario sigue existiendo y activo en la BD
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id: payload.sub },
      select: { id: true, email: true, role: true, name: true, isActive: true, supplierId: true },
    });

    if (!user || !user.isActive) {
      this.logger.warn(`Token válido pero usuario ${payload.sub} inactivo o eliminado`);
      throw new UnauthorizedException('Usuario no encontrado o inactivo');
    }

    // Este objeto estará disponible en req.user en todos los endpoints
    return {
      id: user.id,
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      name: user.name,
      supplierId: user.supplierId ?? undefined,
    };
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/auth.controller.ts
================
import {
  Controller,
  Post,
  Get,
  Body,
  Param,
  Patch,
  ParseIntPipe,
  UseGuards,
  HttpCode,
  HttpStatus,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { LoginDto, RegisterDto } from './dto/auth.dto';
import { UpdateUserDto } from './dto/update-user.dto';
import { JwtAuthGuard } from './guards/jwt-auth.guard';
import { RolesGuard } from './guards/roles.guard';
import { Roles, CurrentUser } from './decorators/auth.decorators';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from './auth.types';

@Controller('auth')
export class AuthController {
  constructor(private readonly authService: AuthService) {}

  // ── Rutas públicas (sin autenticación) ────────────────────

  /** POST /api/auth/login */
  @Post('login')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.OK)
  login(@Body() dto: LoginDto) {
    return this.authService.login(dto);
  }

  /**
   * POST /api/auth/register
   * Registro público: solo crea usuarios con rol CLIENTE.
   * Para crear MECANICO/GERENTE usar el endpoint de admin.
   */
  @Post('register')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  register(@Body() dto: RegisterDto) {
    // Forzar CLIENTE en registro público
    return this.authService.register({ ...dto, role: Role.CLIENTE, supplierId: undefined });
  }

  // ── Rutas autenticadas ─────────────────────────────────────

  /** GET /api/auth/me → Perfil del usuario logueado */
  @Get('me')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard)
  getProfile(@CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    return { user };
  }

  // ── Rutas exclusivas del GERENTE ──────────────────────────

  /** GET /api/auth/users → Lista todos los usuarios */
  @Get('users')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  findAllUsers() {
    return this.authService.findAllUsers();
  }

  /**
   * POST /api/auth/admin/create → El gerente crea usuarios con cualquier rol
   */
  @Post('admin/create')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.CREATED)
  adminCreateUser(@Body() dto: RegisterDto) {
    return this.authService.register(dto);
  }

  /** PATCH /api/auth/users/:id/role → Cambiar rol de un usuario */
  @Patch('users/:id/role')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  changeRole(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body('role') role: Role,
  ) {
    return this.authService.changeUserRole(id, role);
  }

  /** PATCH /api/auth/users/:id → Editar el perfil completo de un usuario */
  @Patch('users/:id')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  updateUser(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() dto: UpdateUserDto,
  ) {
    return this.authService.updateUser(id, dto);
  }

  /** PATCH /api/auth/users/:id/toggle → Activar/desactivar usuario */
  @Patch('users/:id/toggle')
  @UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE)
  toggleActive(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body('isActive') isActive: boolean,
  ) {
    return this.authService.toggleUserActive(id, isActive);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/auth/auth.module.ts
================
import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { JwtModule } from '@nestjs/jwt';
import { PassportModule } from '@nestjs/passport';
import { ConfigModule, ConfigService } from '@nestjs/config';
import { AuthController } from './auth.controller';
import { AuthService } from './auth.service';
import { JwtStrategy } from './strategies/jwt.strategy';

@Module({
  imports: [
    PassportModule.register({ defaultStrategy: 'jwt' }),

    // JWT con secret tomado del .env y expiración configurable
    JwtModule.registerAsync({
      imports: [ConfigModule],
      inject: [ConfigService],
      useFactory: (config: ConfigService) => ({
        secret: config.getOrThrow<string>('JWT_SECRET'),
        signOptions: {
          expiresIn: config.get<string>('JWT_EXPIRES_IN', '8h'),
        },
      }),
    }),
  ],
  controllers: [AuthController],
  providers: [AuthService, JwtStrategy],
  exports: [JwtModule, PassportModule, AuthService],
})
export class AuthModule {}

@Roles(Role.CLIENTE)

File: backend/src/inventory/dto/create-part.dto.ts

import {
  IsString,
  IsInt,
  IsNumber,
  IsOptional,
  IsUrl,
  IsArray,
  Min,
  MaxLength,
  Matches,
} from 'class-validator';

export class CreatePartDto {
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(150)
  name: string;

  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(50)
  @Matches(/^[A-Z0-9\-]+$/, {
    message: 'El código solo puede contener letras mayúsculas, números y guiones',
  })
  code: string;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  quantity: number;

  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  boxId: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  description?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsUrl()
  photoUrl?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsArray()
  @IsString({ each: true })
  keywords?: string[];

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(0)
  minStock?: number;

  /** Precio unitario de referencia; se congela en UsedPart al consumir la pieza. */
  @IsOptional()
  @IsNumber({ maxDecimalPlaces: 2 })
  @Min(0)
  unitPrice?: number;
}

import { Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { ConfigModule } from '@nestjs/config';
import { ledDriverProvider } from './drivers/led-driver.provider';
import { LedControllerService } from './led-controller.service';
import { LedIndicatorService } from './led-indicator.service';
import { ledConfig } from './led.config';
import { LedGateway } from './led.gateway';
import { LOCATION_INDICATOR } from './led.types';

/**
 * Hardware de señalización (tira WS2812B + Socket.io).
 * No depende de ningún otro módulo de negocio. Otros módulos encienden LEDs
 * inyectando el puerto `LOCATION_INDICATOR`.
 */
@Module({
  imports: [ConfigModule.forFeature(ledConfig)],
  providers: [
    ledDriverProvider,
    LedControllerService,
    LedIndicatorService,
    { provide: LOCATION_INDICATOR, useExisting: LedIndicatorService },
    LedGateway,
  ],
  exports: [LedControllerService, LedIndicatorService, LOCATION_INDICATOR],
})
export class LedModule {}

File: backend/src/purchases/dto/purchase.dto.ts

import { PurchaseOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { IsDateString, IsEnum, IsInt, IsOptional, Min } from 'class-validator';
import { CreatePurchaseOrderDto } from '../../supplier/dto/purchase-order.dto';

/**
 * Misma forma y validación que el pedido de reposición existente
 * (supplierId, items[{ partId, quantity, unitPrice? }]). El código OC-YYYY-NNN
 * lo genera el servidor.
 */
export class CreatePurchaseDto extends CreatePurchaseOrderDto {}

/**
 * Solo pedidos PENDIENTES pueden editarse. Estado admitido: CANCELADA.
 * La recepción (RECIBIDA) incrementa stock y se hace en
 * POST /api/suppliers/purchase-orders/:id/receive.
 */
export class UpdatePurchaseDto {
  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  supplierId?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsEnum(PurchaseOrderStatus)
  status?: PurchaseOrderStatus;
}

export class SupplierPurchaseResponseDto {
  @IsEnum(PurchaseOrderStatus, {
    message: 'El estado debe ser CONFIRMADA o RECHAZADA',
  })
  status: 'CONFIRMADA' | 'RECHAZADA';

  @IsOptional()
  @IsDateString()
  expectedDeliveryAt?: string;
}

================
File: backend/src/purchases/purchases.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { PurchaseOrderStatus, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { ForbiddenException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { SupplierService } from '../supplier/supplier.service';
import {
  CreatePurchaseDto,
  SupplierPurchaseResponseDto,
  UpdatePurchaseDto,
} from './dto/purchase.dto';

const PURCHASE_INCLUDE = {
  supplier: true,
  items: { include: { part: true } },
} as const;

@Injectable()
export class PurchasesService {
  constructor(
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
    private readonly supplierService: SupplierService,
  ) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findMany({
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const order = await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Pedido con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return order;
  }

  /** Reutiliza las reglas de negocio existentes (piezas bajo stock mínimo). */
  create(dto: CreatePurchaseDto) {
    return this.supplierService.createPurchaseOrder(dto);
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdatePurchaseDto) {
    const order = await this.findOne(id);
    if (order.status !== PurchaseOrderStatus.PENDIENTE) {
      throw new ConflictException('Solo se pueden modificar pedidos pendientes');
    }
    if (dto.status === PurchaseOrderStatus.RECIBIDA) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Para recibir el pedido usa POST /api/suppliers/purchase-orders/:id/receive (actualiza stock)',
      );
    }
    if (dto.supplierId !== undefined) await this.ensureSupplier(dto.supplierId);

    return this.prisma.purchaseOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: dto,
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    const order = await this.findOne(id);
    if (order.status === PurchaseOrderStatus.RECIBIDA) {
      throw new ConflictException(
        'No se puede eliminar un pedido recibido: ya incrementó el inventario',
      );
    }

    // Los PurchaseOrderItem se eliminan en cascada.
    await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.delete({ where: { id } });
  }

  findSupplierOrders(user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    if (user.role !== Role.PROVEEDOR || !user.supplierId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('El usuario proveedor no está vinculado a un proveedor');
    }
    return this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findMany({
      where: { supplierId: user.supplierId },
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  async respondAsSupplier(
    id: number,
    dto: SupplierPurchaseResponseDto,
    user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {
    if (user.role !== Role.PROVEEDOR || !user.supplierId) {
      throw new ForbiddenException('El usuario proveedor no está vinculado a un proveedor');
    }
    const order = await this.prisma.purchaseOrder.findFirst({
      where: { id, supplierId: user.supplierId },
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Pedido con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    if (order.status !== PurchaseOrderStatus.PENDIENTE) {
      throw new ConflictException('Solo se pueden responder pedidos pendientes');
    }
    return this.prisma.purchaseOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status: dto.status,
        expectedDeliveryAt: dto.expectedDeliveryAt
          ? new Date(dto.expectedDeliveryAt)
          : undefined,
      },
      include: PURCHASE_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  private async ensureSupplier(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.supplier.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Proveedor con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/service/service.service.ts
================
import {
  BadRequestException,
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { AuthenticatedUser } from '../auth/auth.types';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { workOrderScope } from '../work-orders/work-order-scope';

const WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE = { vehicle: true, parts: { include: { part: true } } } as const;

/**
 * Transiciones operativas de órdenes (estado, diagnóstico y cierre). El stock
 * se descuenta al agregar repuestos (WorkOrdersService, RF-INV-13). El CRUD de vehículos y la creación/listado de órdenes
 * viven en VehiclesService y WorkOrdersService; ServiceController delega en ellos.
 * Un MECANICO solo puede operar órdenes asignadas a él (workOrderScope).
 */
@Injectable()
export class ServiceService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  async updateWorkOrderStatus(id: number, status: WorkOrderStatus, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una orden concluida no puede cambiar de estado');
    }
    if (status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new BadRequestException(
        'Para concluir la orden usa PATCH /api/service/work-orders/:id/close',
      );
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: {
        status,
        // Solo la primera vez: reanudar desde ESPERA_REPUESTOS no reinicia la fecha.
        startedAt:
          status === WorkOrderStatus.EN_PROCESO && !order.startedAt ? new Date() : undefined,
      },
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  async diagnoseWorkOrder(id: number, diagnosis: string, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('Una orden concluida no puede modificarse');
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.update({
      where: { id },
      data: { diagnosis, status: WorkOrderStatus.EN_DIAGNOSTICO },
      include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Concluye la orden (finalCost + completedAt). No toca inventario: por
   * RF-INV-13 cada UsedPart ya descontó stock al agregarse a la orden.
   */
  async closeWorkOrder(id: number, finalCost: number | undefined, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.findWorkOrder(id, user);
    if (order.status === WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO) {
      throw new ConflictException('La orden de trabajo ya está concluida');
    }
    // Condición en el WHERE: si otra petición la concluyó entre medio, no se repite.
    const updated = await this.prisma.workOrder.updateMany({
      where: { id, status: { not: WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO } },
      data: { status: WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO, finalCost, completedAt: new Date() },
    });
    if (updated.count === 0) {
      throw new ConflictException('La orden de trabajo ya está concluida');
    }
    return this.prisma.workOrder.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id }, include: WORK_ORDER_INCLUDE });
  }

  /** Fuera del alcance del usuario responde 404 (no revela que existe). */
  private async findWorkOrder(id: number, user: AuthenticatedUser) {
    const order = await this.prisma.workOrder.findFirst({
      where: { id, ...workOrderScope(user) },
    });
    if (!order) throw new NotFoundException(`Orden de trabajo con id ${id} no encontrada`);
    return order;
  }
}

  @IsOptional()

  @Min(1)

}

import { RolesGuard } from '../auth/guards/roles.guard';
import { CreateUserDto, UpdateUserDto, UserLookupQueryDto } from './dto/user.dto';
import { UsersService } from './users.service';

/** /api/users — Administración de usuarios (solo GERENTE). */
@Controller('users')
@UseGuards(JwtAuthGuard, RolesGuard)
@Roles(Role.GERENTE)
export class UsersController {
  constructor(private readonly usersService: UsersService) {}

  @Get()
  findAll() {
    return this.usersService.findAll();
  }

  /** Selector de usuarios por rol (p. ej. dueño de un vehículo). También MECANICO. */
  @Get('lookup')
  @Roles(Role.GERENTE, Role.MECANICO)
  lookup(@Query() query: UserLookupQueryDto) {
    return this.usersService.lookup(query.role);
  }

  }

    return this.usersService.create(dto);
  }

    return this.usersService.update(id, dto);
  }

  @Delete(':id(\\d+)')
  @HttpCode(HttpStatus.NO_CONTENT)
  remove(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @CurrentUser() user: AuthenticatedUser,
  ) {

File: backend/src/users/users.service.ts
================
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Prisma, Role } from '@prisma/client';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateUserDto, UpdateUserDto } from './dto/user.dto';

const BCRYPT_ROUNDS = 10;

/** Campos públicos: nunca se expone `password`. */
const USER_SELECT = {
  id: true,
  name: true,
  email: true,
  role: true,
  isActive: true,
  createdAt: true,
  updatedAt: true,
  supplierId: true,
} satisfies Prisma.UserSelect;

@Injectable()
export class UsersService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.user.findMany({
      select: USER_SELECT,
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  /** Usuarios activos de un rol con datos mínimos (id, nombre, correo). */
  lookup(role: Role) {
    return this.prisma.user.findMany({
      where: { role, isActive: true },
      select: { id: true, name: true, email: true },
      orderBy: { name: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const user = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: USER_SELECT,
    });
    if (!user) throw new NotFoundException(`Usuario con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return user;
  }

  async create(dto: CreateUserDto) {
    await this.validateSupplierAssignment(dto.role ?? Role.CLIENTE, dto.supplierId);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.user.create({
        data: {
          ...dto,
          role: dto.role ?? Role.CLIENTE,
          password: await bcrypt.hash(dto.password, BCRYPT_ROUNDS),
        },
        select: USER_SELECT,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicateEmail(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateUserDto) {
    const current = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id } });
    if (!current) throw new NotFoundException(`Usuario con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    await this.validateSupplierAssignment(
      dto.role ?? current.role,
      dto.supplierId ?? current.supplierId ?? undefined,
    );
    try {
      return await this.prisma.user.update({
        where: { id },
        data: {
          ...dto,
          password: dto.password
            ? await bcrypt.hash(dto.password, BCRYPT_ROUNDS)
            : undefined,
        },
        select: USER_SELECT,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicateEmail(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async remove(id: number, currentUserId: number) {
    if (id === currentUserId) {
      throw new ConflictException('No puedes eliminar tu propio usuario');
    }
    await this.findOne(id);
    try {
      await this.prisma.user.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2003')) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'El usuario tiene vehículos o facturas asociadas; desactívalo en lugar de eliminarlo',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private throwDuplicateEmail(error: unknown) {
    if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
      throw new ConflictException('El correo electrónico ya está registrado');
    }
  }

  private async validateSupplierAssignment(role: Role, supplierId?: number) {
    if (role === Role.PROVEEDOR && !supplierId) {
      throw new ConflictException('Un usuario PROVEEDOR debe estar vinculado a un proveedor');
    }
    if (role !== Role.PROVEEDOR && supplierId) {
      throw new ConflictException('Solo los usuarios PROVEEDOR pueden vincular un proveedor');
    }
    if (supplierId) {
      const supplier = await this.prisma.supplier.findUnique({ where: { id: supplierId } });
      if (!supplier) throw new NotFoundException('Proveedor no encontrado');
    }
  }
}

================
File: backend/src/vehicles/dto/vehicle.dto.ts
================
import { PartialType } from '@nestjs/mapped-types';
import { Transform } from 'class-transformer';
import { IsInt, IsNotEmpty, IsOptional, IsString, Max, MaxLength, Min } from 'class-validator';

const toUpperTrimmed = ({ value }: { value: unknown }) =>
  typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().toUpperCase() : value;

export class CreateVehicleDto {
  /** Se normaliza a mayúsculas sin espacios externos ("abc-123 " → "ABC-123"). */
  @Transform(toUpperTrimmed)
  @IsString()
  @IsNotEmpty()
  @MaxLength(20)
  plate: string;

  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(80)
  make: string;

  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(80)
  model: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1886)
  @Max(2100)
  year?: number;

  @IsOptional()
  @Transform(toUpperTrimmed)
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(17)
  vin?: string;

  @IsOptional()
  @IsString()
  @MaxLength(50)
  color?: string;

  /** Cliente propietario del vehículo (rol CLIENTE, activo) */
  @IsInt()
  @Min(1)
  ownerId: number;
}

export class UpdateVehicleDto extends PartialType(CreateVehicleDto) {}

File: backend/src/vehicles/vehicles.service.ts
================
import {
  ConflictException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';
import { isPrismaError } from '../common/prisma-errors';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service';
import { CreateVehicleDto, UpdateVehicleDto } from './dto/vehicle.dto';

const OWNER_SELECT = { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } as const;

@Injectable()
export class VehiclesService {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaService) {}

  findAll() {
    return this.prisma.vehicle.findMany({
      include: { owner: OWNER_SELECT },
      orderBy: { plate: 'asc' },
    });
  }

  async findOne(id: number) {
    const vehicle = await this.prisma.vehicle.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      include: {
        owner: OWNER_SELECT,
        workOrders: { orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' } },
        appointments: { orderBy: { scheduledAt: 'desc' } },
      },
    });
    if (!vehicle) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    return vehicle;
  }

  /** RF-SER-01: registra un vehículo validando que la placa no exista. */
  async create(dto: CreateVehicleDto) {
    await this.ensureOwner(dto.ownerId);
    await this.ensurePlateAvailable(dto.plate);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.vehicle.create({
        data: dto,
        include: { owner: OWNER_SELECT },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicate(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async update(id: number, dto: UpdateVehicleDto) {
    await this.ensureExists(id);
    if (dto.ownerId !== undefined) await this.ensureOwner(dto.ownerId);
    if (dto.plate !== undefined) await this.ensurePlateAvailable(dto.plate, id);
    try {
      return await this.prisma.vehicle.update({
        where: { id },
        data: dto,
        include: { owner: OWNER_SELECT },
      });
    } catch (error) {
      this.throwDuplicate(error);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async remove(id: number) {
    await this.ensureExists(id);
    try {
      await this.prisma.vehicle.delete({ where: { id } });
    } catch (error) {
      if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2003')) {
        throw new ConflictException(
          'No se puede eliminar un vehículo con órdenes o citas asociadas',
        );
      }
      throw error;
    }
  }

  private async ensureExists(id: number) {
    const count = await this.prisma.vehicle.count({ where: { id } });
    if (count === 0) throw new NotFoundException(`Vehículo con id ${id} no encontrado`);
  }

  private async ensureOwner(id: number) {
    const owner = await this.prisma.user.findUnique({
      where: { id },
      select: { role: true, isActive: true },
    });
    if (!owner) throw new NotFoundException(`Usuario con id ${id} no encontrado`);
    if (owner.role !== Role.CLIENTE || !owner.isActive) {
      throw new ConflictException('El propietario debe ser un cliente activo');
    }
  }

  /**
   * Comparación sin distinguir mayúsculas para cubrir placas antiguas no
   * normalizadas. El índice único de `plate` sigue cubriendo la concurrencia.
   */
  private async ensurePlateAvailable(plate: string, excludeId?: number) {
    const existing = await this.prisma.vehicle.findFirst({
      where: {
        plate: { equals: plate, mode: 'insensitive' },
        ...(excludeId !== undefined && { id: { not: excludeId } }),
      },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (existing) throw new ConflictException(`La placa "${plate}" ya está registrada`);
  }

  private throwDuplicate(error: unknown) {
    if (isPrismaError(error, 'P2002')) {
      throw new ConflictException('La placa o VIN ya está registrado');
    }
  }
}

import { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { formatDocumentNumber, nextDocumentNumber } from '../common/document-number';

/** RF-SER-05: código correlativo OT-YYYY-NNN (ver common/document-number.ts). */
export function formatWorkOrderNumber(year: number, sequence: number): string {
  return formatDocumentNumber('OT', year, sequence);
}

/** DEBE ejecutarse dentro de la transacción que crea la orden. */
export function nextWorkOrderNumber(tx: Prisma.TransactionClient, date?: Date): Promise<string> {
  return nextDocumentNumber(tx, 'OT', date);
}

File: frontend/src/api/errors.ts
================
import { isAxiosError } from 'axios';

/** Error de validación de un formulario: su mensaje se muestra tal cual al usuario. */
export class UserInputError extends Error {}

/** Extrae el mensaje de error de NestJS (string o arreglo de class-validator). */
export function getApiErrorMessage(error: unknown, fallback: string): string {
  if (isAxiosError<{ message?: string | string[] }>(error)) {
    const message = error.response?.data?.message;
    if (Array.isArray(message)) return message.join('. ');
    if (message) return message;
  }
  if (error instanceof UserInputError) return error.message;
  return fallback;
}

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Search, Plus, Package } from 'lucide-react';
import api from '../../api/axios';
import PartFormModal, { PartFormValues } from './PartFormModal';

interface InventoryPart {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  quantity: number;
  minStock: number;
  unitPrice: string | null;
  keywords: string[];
  box?: {
    id: number;
    name: string;
  };
}

const toFormValues = (part: InventoryPart): PartFormValues => ({
  id: part.id,
  name: part.name,
  code: part.code,
  quantity: part.quantity,
  boxId: part.box?.id ?? 0,
  minStock: part.minStock,
  unitPrice: part.unitPrice ?? '',
  keywords: part.keywords,
});

export default function InventoryList() {
  const [parts, setParts] = useState<InventoryPart[]>([]);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedPart, setSelectedPart] = useState<PartFormValues | null>(null);

  const loadParts = async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await api.get<InventoryPart[]>('/inventory/parts');
      setParts(response.data);
      setError(null);
    } catch (requestError) {
      console.error('Error al cargar las piezas', requestError);
      setError('No se pudieron cargar las piezas.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadParts();
  }, []);

  const filteredParts = useMemo(() => {
    const normalizedSearch = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    if (!normalizedSearch) {
      return parts;
    }

    return parts.filter(
      (part) =>
        part.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch) ||
        part.code.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedSearch),
    );
  }, [parts, search]);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge">
              <Package size={24} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Inventario</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
                Gestiona las piezas almacenadas.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setSelectedPart(null);
            setIsModalOpen(true);
          }}
          className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-400 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-slate-900 btn-primary"
        >
          <Plus size={18} />
          Nueva Pieza
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-4">
        <label htmlFor="inventory-search" className="sr-only">
          Buscar piezas
        </label>
        <div className="relative">
          <Search
            size={18}
            className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
          />
          <input
            id="inventory-search"
            type="search"
            value={search}
            onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Buscar por nombre o código..."
            className="w-full rounded-xl py-2.5 pl-10 pr-4 text-slate-100 transition-colors focus:ring-1 focus:ring-brand-500 glass-input"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="glass overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">Cargando piezas...</div>
        ) : error ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-red-400">{error}</div>
        ) : filteredParts.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
            No se encontraron piezas.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] text-left text-sm">
              <thead className="border-b border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03]">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Pieza</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Código</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Caja</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Stock</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-right font-semibold text-slate-300">Acciones</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                {filteredParts.map((part) => (
                  <tr key={part.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-white/5">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-white">{part.name}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-400">{part.code}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-400">
                      {part.box?.name ?? 'Sin caja'}
                    </td>
                    <td
                      className={`px-6 py-4 font-semibold ${
                        part.quantity <= part.minStock
                          ? 'text-amber-400'
                          : 'text-emerald-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {part.quantity}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-right">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          setSelectedPart(toFormValues(part));
                          setIsModalOpen(true);
                        }}
                        className="font-medium text-brand-400 transition-colors hover:text-brand-300"
                      >
                        Editar
                      </button>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <PartFormModal
        isOpen={isModalOpen}
        part={selectedPart}
        onClose={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}
        onSaved={() => {
          void loadParts();
        }}
      />
    </section>
  );
}
