File: frontend/src/components/Inventory/PartFormModal.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';

interface InventoryBox {
  id: number;
  name: string;
}

export interface PartFormValues {
  id?: number;
  name: string;
  code: string;
  quantity: number;
  boxId: number;
  minStock: number;
  /** '' = sin precio. Se congela en cada OT al consumir la pieza. */
  unitPrice: string;
  keywords: string[];
}

interface PartFormModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  part?: PartFormValues | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSaved: () => void;
}

const emptyForm: PartFormValues = {
  name: '',
  code: '',
  quantity: 0,
  boxId: 0,
  minStock: 1,
  unitPrice: '',
  keywords: [],
};

export default function PartFormModal({
  isOpen,
  part,
  onClose,
  onSaved,
}: PartFormModalProps) {
  const [boxes, setBoxes] = useState<InventoryBox[]>([]);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<PartFormValues>(emptyForm);
  const [keywordsText, setKeywordsText] = useState('');
  const [isLoadingBoxes, setIsLoadingBoxes] = useState(false);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      return;
    }

    setForm(part ?? emptyForm);
    setKeywordsText(part?.keywords.join(', ') ?? '');

    const loadBoxes = async () => {
      setIsLoadingBoxes(true);
      try {
        const response = await api.get<InventoryBox[]>('/inventory/boxes');
        setBoxes(response.data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar las cajas', error);
        toast.error('No se pudieron cargar las cajas disponibles.');
      } finally {
        setIsLoadingBoxes(false);
      }
    };

    void loadBoxes();
  }, [isOpen, part]);

  if (!isOpen) {
    return null;
  }

  const updateField = <K extends keyof PartFormValues>(
    field: K,
    value: PartFormValues[K],
  ) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    const payload = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      code: form.code.trim(),
      quantity: form.quantity,
      boxId: form.boxId,
      minStock: form.minStock,
      unitPrice: form.unitPrice.trim() === '' ? undefined : Number(form.unitPrice),
      keywords: keywordsText
        .split(',')
        .map((keyword) => keyword.trim())
        .filter(Boolean),
    };

    try {
      if (part?.id) {
        await api.put(`/inventory/parts/${part.id}`, payload);
        toast.success('Pieza actualizada correctamente.');
      } else {
        await api.post('/inventory/parts', payload);
        toast.success('Pieza creada correctamente.');
      }

      onSaved();
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al guardar la pieza', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo guardar la pieza.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 glass-overlay"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-labelledby="part-form-title"
    >
      <div className="glass-strong max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-2xl overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl shadow-2xl">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-4">
          <h2 id="part-form-title" className="text-xl font-bold text-white">
            {part ? 'Editar pieza' : 'Nueva pieza'}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="rounded-lg p-2 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white"
            aria-label="Cerrar modal"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-5 p-6">
          <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Nombre
              <input
                required
                maxLength={150}
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('name', event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Código
              <input
                required
                maxLength={50}
                value={form.code}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('code', event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Cantidad
              <input
                required
                min={0}
                type="number"
                value={form.quantity}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('quantity', Number(event.target.value))}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Stock mínimo
              <input
                required
                min={0}
                type="number"
                value={form.minStock}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('minStock', Number(event.target.value))}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300">
              Precio unitario
              <input
                min={0}
                step="0.01"
                type="number"
                inputMode="decimal"
                placeholder="0.00"
                value={form.unitPrice}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('unitPrice', event.target.value)}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              />
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300 sm:col-span-2">
              Caja
              <select
                required
                value={form.boxId || ''}
                disabled={isLoadingBoxes}
                onChange={(event) => updateField('boxId', Number(event.target.value))}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              >
                <option value="" disabled>
                  {isLoadingBoxes ? 'Cargando cajas...' : 'Selecciona una caja'}
                </option>
                {boxes.map((box) => (
                  <option key={box.id} value={box.id}>
                    {box.name}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="space-y-2 text-sm text-slate-300 sm:col-span-2">
              Keywords
              <input
                value={keywordsText}
                onChange={(event) => setKeywordsText(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="filtro, aceite, motor"
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-white glass-input"
              />
              <span className="block text-xs text-slate-500">
                Separa las palabras clave con comas.
              </span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 border-t border-white/10 pt-5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5"
            >
              Cancelar
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={isSubmitting || isLoadingBoxes}
              className="rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60 btn-primary"
            >
              {isSubmitting ? 'Guardando...' : 'Guardar pieza'}
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Suppliers/SuppliersList.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle, PackageCheck, Truck } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';

interface Supplier { id: number; name: string; email?: string; phone?: string }
interface LowStockPart { id: number; name: string; code: string; quantity: number; minStock: number }

export default function SuppliersList() {
  const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState<Supplier[]>([]);
  const [lowStock, setLowStock] = useState<LowStockPart[]>([]);
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const load = async () => {
    try {
      const [supplierResponse, stockResponse] = await Promise.all([
        api.get<Supplier[]>('/suppliers'),
        api.get<LowStockPart[]>('/suppliers/low-stock'),
      ]);
      setSuppliers(supplierResponse.data);
      setLowStock(stockResponse.data);
      if (!supplierId && supplierResponse.data[0]) setSupplierId(String(supplierResponse.data[0].id));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cargar abastecimiento', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo cargar la información de proveedores.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => { void load(); }, []);

  const requestRestock = async (part: LowStockPart) => {
    if (!supplierId) {
      toast.error('Selecciona un proveedor.');
      return;
    }
    try {
      await api.post('/suppliers/purchase-orders', {
        supplierId: Number(supplierId),
        items: [{ partId: part.id, quantity: Math.max(part.minStock * 2 - part.quantity, 1) }],
      });
      toast.success(`Reposición solicitada para ${part.name}.`);
      setLowStock((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== part.id));
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo registrar la reposición.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3"><div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge"><Truck size={24} /></div><div><h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Proveedores y abastecimiento</h2><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Solicita reposiciones cuando el stock esté bajo.</p></div></header>
      <div className="glass rounded-2xl p-5"><label className="mb-2 block text-sm text-slate-400">Proveedor para nuevas solicitudes</label><select value={supplierId} onChange={(event) => setSupplierId(event.target.value)} className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white glass-input">{suppliers.map((supplier) => <option key={supplier.id} value={supplier.id}>{supplier.name}</option>)}</select></div>
      <div className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/30 bg-white/[0.03]">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/10 p-5 text-amber-400"><AlertTriangle size={20} /><h3 className="font-semibold">Alertas de stock mínimo</h3></div>
        {loading ? <p className="p-6 text-slate-400">Cargando alertas...</p> : lowStock.length === 0 ? <p className="p-6 text-emerald-400">No hay piezas bajo el mínimo.</p> : <div className="divide-y divide-white/5">{lowStock.map((part) => <div key={part.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 p-5 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"><div><p className="font-medium text-white">{part.name}</p><p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{part.code} · Stock: <span className="text-amber-400">{part.quantity}</span> / mínimo {part.minStock}</p></div><button type="button" onClick={() => void requestRestock(part)} className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-white btn-primary"><PackageCheck size={17} /> Solicitar reposición</button></div>)}</div>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/DataTable.tsx
================
import { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, Eye, Inbox, Pencil, RotateCw, Trash2, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export interface Column<T> {
  key: string;
  header: string;
  render: (row: T) => ReactNode;
  /** Oculta la columna en pantallas pequeñas (< md). */
  hideOnMobile?: boolean;
  align?: 'left' | 'right';
}

/** Acción adicional de una fila (p. ej. "Recibir pedido", "Marcar pagada"). */
export interface RowAction {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Texto visible del botón (≥ sm); `label` queda como tooltip y para lectores de pantalla. */
  shortLabel: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  tone?: 'brand' | 'success' | 'danger';
  onClick: () => void;
}

/** Acciones de negocio: botón con ícono + texto, coloreado según su efecto. */
const actionTone: Record<NonNullable<RowAction['tone']>, string> = {
  brand: 'border-brand-400/25 bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-300 hover:bg-brand-500/20',
  success: 'border-emerald-400/25 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-500/20',
  danger: 'border-red-400/25 bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 hover:bg-red-500/20',
};

interface DataTableProps<T extends { id: number }> {
  columns: Column<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  emptyMessage: string;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onView?: (row: T) => void;
  onEdit?: (row: T) => void;
  onDelete?: (row: T) => void;
  /** Si se define, Editar solo aparece en las filas que lo cumplan. */
  isEditable?: (row: T) => boolean;
  /** Acciones adicionales por fila; se muestran antes de Ver/Editar/Eliminar. */
  rowActions?: (row: T) => RowAction[];
}

const SKELETON_ROWS = 5;

function cellClass(column: { hideOnMobile?: boolean; align?: 'left' | 'right' }): string {
  return [
    'whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-3 sm:px-6',
    column.hideOnMobile ? 'hidden md:table-cell' : '',
    column.align === 'right' ? 'text-right' : 'text-left',
  ].join(' ');
}

const actionButton =
  'rounded-lg p-2 text-slate-400 transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-500';

export default function DataTable<T extends { id: number }>({
  columns,
  rows,
  isLoading,
  error,
  emptyMessage,
  onRetry,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  isEditable,
  rowActions,
}: DataTableProps<T>) {
  const hasActions = Boolean(onView || onEdit || onDelete || rowActions);

  if (error && !isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-3 p-10 text-center">
        <AlertCircle className="text-red-400" size={28} />
        <p className="text-slate-300">{error}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200 btn-secondary"
        >
          <RotateCw size={16} /> Reintentar
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
      <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-white/5 text-sm">
        <thead className="bg-white/[0.03] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
          <tr>
            {columns.map((column) => (
              <th key={column.key} scope="col" className={`${cellClass(column)} font-semibold`}>
                {column.header}
              </th>
            ))}
            {hasActions && (
              <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold sm:px-6">
                <span className="sr-only">Acciones</span>
              </th>
            )}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5" aria-busy={isLoading}>
          {isLoading &&
            Array.from({ length: SKELETON_ROWS }, (_, index) => (
              <tr key={index} className="animate-pulse">
                {columns.map((column) => (
                  <td key={column.key} className={cellClass(column)}>
                    <div className="h-4 w-3/4 rounded bg-white/10" />
                  </td>
                ))}
                {hasActions && (
                  <td className="px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
                    <div className="ml-auto h-4 w-16 rounded bg-white/10" />
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}

          {!isLoading && rows.length === 0 && (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={columns.length + (hasActions ? 1 : 0)} className="px-6 py-12">
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 text-slate-400">
                  <Inbox size={28} />
                  <p>{emptyMessage}</p>
                </div>
              </td>
            </tr>
          )}

          {!isLoading &&
            rows.map((row) => (
              <tr key={row.id} className="text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:bg-white/5">
                {columns.map((column) => (
                  <td key={column.key} className={cellClass(column)}>
                    {column.render(row)}
                  </td>
                ))}
                {hasActions && (
                  <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-4 py-2 text-right sm:px-6">
                    {rowActions?.(row).map(({ key, label, shortLabel, icon: Icon, tone = 'brand', onClick }) => (
                      <button
                        key={key}
                        type="button"
                        title={label}
                        aria-label={label}
                        onClick={onClick}
                        className={`mr-1 inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${actionTone[tone]}`}
                      >
                        <Icon size={15} />
                        <span className="hidden sm:inline">{shortLabel}</span>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                    {onView && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title="Ver detalles"
                        aria-label="Ver detalles"
                        onClick={() => onView(row)}
                        className={`${actionButton} hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white`}
                      >
                        <Eye size={17} />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {onEdit && (!isEditable || isEditable(row)) && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title="Editar"
                        aria-label="Editar"
                        onClick={() => onEdit(row)}
                        className={`${actionButton} hover:bg-brand-500/10 hover:text-brand-400`}
                      >
                        <Pencil size={17} />
                      </button>
                    )}
                    {onDelete && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        title="Eliminar"
                        aria-label="Eliminar"
                        onClick={() => onDelete(row)}
                        className={`${actionButton} hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400`}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={17} />
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </td>
                )}
              </tr>
            ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/ResourceListPage.tsx
================
import { ReactNode, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, X, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import DataTable, { Column, RowAction } from './DataTable';
import ResourceFormModal, { FormField, FormValues } from './ResourceFormModal';

/** Alta de registros. Sin esta config no se muestra "Nuevo Registro". */
export interface CreateFormConfig {
  title: string;
  fields: FormField[];
  initialValues: FormValues;
  /** Debe lanzar en error (el modal muestra el mensaje y queda abierto). */
  submit: (values: FormValues) => Promise<unknown>;
  successMessage: string;
}

/** Edición de un registro existente. */
export interface EditFormConfig<T> {
  title: (row: T) => string;
  fields: (row: T) => FormField[];
  initialValues: (row: T) => FormValues;
  submit: (row: T, values: FormValues) => Promise<unknown>;
  /** Filas que admiten edición (p. ej. solo pedidos PENDIENTES). */
  isEditable?: (row: T) => boolean;
}

/** Acción de negocio por fila; `run` devuelve el mensaje de éxito. */
export interface ResourceRowAction {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Texto corto visible en el botón (p. ej. "Recibir"). */
  shortLabel: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  tone?: RowAction['tone'];
  /** Si se define, se pide confirmación antes de ejecutar. */
  confirm?: string;
  run: () => Promise<string>;
}

interface ResourceListPageProps<T extends { id: number }> {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /** Nombre singular del registro, usado en mensajes ("el vehículo"). */
  entityLabel: string;
  /** Debe ser una referencia estable (p. ej. `vehiclesApi.list`). */
  fetchAll: () => Promise<T[]>;
  columns: Column<T>[];
  emptyMessage: string;
  getRowLabel: (row: T) => string;
  /** Solo se pasa si el rol actual puede eliminar (el backend exige GERENTE). */
  onDelete?: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
  createForm?: CreateFormConfig;
  editForm?: EditFormConfig<T>;
  rowActions?: (row: T) => ResourceRowAction[];
  /** Contenido extra sobre el encabezado (p. ej. pestañas de vista). */
  toolbar?: ReactNode;
}

type FormState<T> = { mode: 'create' } | { mode: 'edit'; row: T } | null;

/**
 * Página de listado CRUD: encabezado + "Nuevo Registro" + tabla con carga,
 * error, vacío, Ver/Editar/Eliminar y acciones de negocio por fila. Tras cada
 * mutación se recarga el listado (las respuestas pueden traer menos relaciones).
 */
export default function ResourceListPage<T extends { id: number }>({
  title,
  description,
  icon: Icon,
  entityLabel,
  fetchAll,
  columns,
  emptyMessage,
  getRowLabel,
  onDelete,
  createForm,
  editForm,
  rowActions,
  toolbar,
}: ResourceListPageProps<T>) {
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<T[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [formState, setFormState] = useState<FormState<T>>(null);
  const [viewing, setViewing] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [busyAction, setBusyAction] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const latestRequest = useRef(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++latestRequest.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await fetchAll();
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setRows(data);
    } catch (loadError) {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) {
        setError(getApiErrorMessage(loadError, `No se pudo cargar el listado de ${title.toLowerCase()}.`));
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [fetchAll, title]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    // Invalida respuestas en vuelo al desmontar.
    return () => {
      latestRequest.current += 1;
    };
  }, [load]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!viewing) return;
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => event.key === 'Escape' && setViewing(null);
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [viewing]);

  const closeForm = useCallback(() => setFormState(null), []);

  const handleDelete = async (row: T) => {
    if (!onDelete) return;
    const confirmed = window.confirm(
      `¿Eliminar ${entityLabel} "${getRowLabel(row)}"? Esta acción no se puede deshacer.`,
    );
    if (!confirmed) return;
    try {
      await onDelete(row.id);
      setRows((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== row.id));
      toast.success(`Se eliminó ${entityLabel} "${getRowLabel(row)}".`);
    } catch (deleteError) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(deleteError, `No se pudo eliminar ${entityLabel}.`));
    }
  };

  const runAction = async (rowId: number, action: ResourceRowAction) => {
    if (busyAction) return;
    if (action.confirm && !window.confirm(action.confirm)) return;
    setBusyAction(`${rowId}:${action.key}`);
    try {
      toast.success(await action.run());
      await load();
    } catch (actionError) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(actionError, `No se pudo completar "${action.label}".`));
    } finally {
      setBusyAction(null);
    }
  };

  const submitForm = async (values: FormValues) => {
    if (!formState) return;
    if (formState.mode === 'create' && createForm) {
      await createForm.submit(values);
      toast.success(createForm.successMessage);
    } else if (formState.mode === 'edit' && editForm) {
      await editForm.submit(formState.row, values);
      toast.success(`Se actualizó ${entityLabel} "${getRowLabel(formState.row)}".`);
    }
    setFormState(null);
    await load();
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      {toolbar}

      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge">
            <Icon size={24} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">{title}</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
              {description}
              {!isLoading && !error && (
                <span className="text-slate-500"> · {rows.length} registros</span>
              )}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        {createForm && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setFormState({ mode: 'create' })}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-300 btn-primary"
          >
            <Plus size={18} /> Nuevo Registro
          </button>
        )}
      </header>

      <div className="glass overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
        <DataTable
          columns={columns}
          rows={rows}
          isLoading={isLoading}
          error={error}
          emptyMessage={emptyMessage}
          onRetry={() => void load()}
          onView={setViewing}
          onEdit={editForm ? (row) => setFormState({ mode: 'edit', row }) : undefined}
          isEditable={editForm?.isEditable}
          onDelete={onDelete ? (row) => void handleDelete(row) : undefined}
          rowActions={
            rowActions
              ? (row) =>
                  rowActions(row).map((action) => ({
                    key: action.key,
                    label: action.label,
                    shortLabel: busyAction === `${row.id}:${action.key}` ? `${action.shortLabel}…` : action.shortLabel,
                    icon: action.icon,
                    tone: action.tone,
                    onClick: () => void runAction(row.id, action),
                  }))
              : undefined
          }
        />
      </div>

      {formState?.mode === 'create' && createForm && (
        <ResourceFormModal
          title={createForm.title}
          submitLabel="Crear"
          fields={createForm.fields}
          initialValues={createForm.initialValues}
          onSubmit={submitForm}
          onClose={closeForm}
        />
      )}
      {formState?.mode === 'edit' && editForm && (
        <ResourceFormModal
          title={editForm.title(formState.row)}
          submitLabel="Guardar cambios"
          fields={editForm.fields(formState.row)}
          initialValues={editForm.initialValues(formState.row)}
          onSubmit={submitForm}
          onClose={closeForm}
        />
      )}

      {viewing && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 glass-overlay"
          onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && setViewing(null)}
        >
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="resource-detail-title"
            className="glass-strong max-h-[90vh] w-full max-w-lg overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl shadow-2xl"
          >
            <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-white/10 p-5">
              <h3 id="resource-detail-title" className="text-lg font-bold text-white">{getRowLabel(viewing)}</h3>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => setViewing(null)} aria-label="Cerrar" className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
                <X size={20} />
              </button>
            </header>
            <dl className="divide-y divide-white/5 p-5">
              {columns.map((column) => (
                <div key={column.key} className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 py-2.5 text-sm">
                  <dt className="text-slate-500">{column.header}</dt>
                  <dd className="col-span-2 text-slate-200">{column.render(viewing)}</dd>
                </div>
              ))}
            </dl>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/ui/StatusBadge.tsx

export type BadgeTone = 'neutral' | 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger' | 'brand';

const toneClasses: Record<BadgeTone, string> = {
  neutral: 'bg-white/5 text-slate-300 border-white/10',
  info: 'bg-sky-500/10 text-sky-300 border-sky-500/30',
  warning: 'bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300 border-amber-500/30',
  success: 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300 border-emerald-500/30',
  danger: 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-300 border-red-500/30',
  brand: 'bg-brand-500/10 text-brand-300 border-brand-500/30',
};

interface StatusBadgeProps {
  label: string;
  tone?: BadgeTone;
}

export default function StatusBadge({ label, tone = 'neutral' }: StatusBadgeProps) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`inline-flex items-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium backdrop-blur-sm ${toneClasses[tone]}`}
    >
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/ui/ViewTabs.tsx

import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export interface ViewTab<TKey extends string> {
  key: TKey;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
}

interface ViewTabsProps<TKey extends string> {
  tabs: ViewTab<TKey>[];
  active: TKey;
  onChange: (key: TKey) => void;
}

/** Alterna entre el listado CRUD y una vista operativa existente del módulo. */
export default function ViewTabs<TKey extends string>({ tabs, active, onChange }: ViewTabsProps<TKey>) {
  return (
    <div role="tablist" className="glass inline-flex rounded-xl p-1">
      {tabs.map(({ key, label, icon: Icon }) => (
        <button
          key={key}
          type="button"
          role="tab"
          aria-selected={active === key}
          onClick={() => onChange(key)}
          className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
            active === key
              ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-400 to-brand-600 text-white shadow-[0_6px_18px_-8px_rgba(249,115,22,0.8)]'
              : 'text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <Icon size={16} /> {label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Users/UsersList.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Plus, ShieldCheck, Users, X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

interface ManagedUser {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  isActive: boolean;
}

const roles: Role[] = [
  'GERENTE',
  'MECANICO',
  'BODEGUERO',
  'CONTADOR',
  'CLIENTE',
  'PROVEEDOR',
];

export default function UsersList() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<ManagedUser[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    name: '',
    email: '',
    password: '',
    role: 'CLIENTE' as Role,
    supplierId: '',
  });

  const loadUsers = async () => {
    try {
      const response = await api.get<ManagedUser[]>('/auth/users');
      setUsers(response.data);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cargar usuarios', error);
      toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los usuarios.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.role === 'GERENTE') void loadUsers();
  }, [user?.role]);

  if (user?.role !== 'GERENTE') {
    return <p className="text-slate-400">No tienes permisos para administrar usuarios.</p>;
  }

  const createUser = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await api.post('/auth/admin/create', {
        ...form,
        supplierId: form.role === 'PROVEEDOR' ? Number(form.supplierId) : undefined,
      });
      toast.success('Usuario creado correctamente.');
      setForm({ name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'CLIENTE', supplierId: '' });
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      await loadUsers();
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'No se pudo crear el usuario.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (managedUser: ManagedUser) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/auth/users/${managedUser.id}/toggle`, { isActive: !managedUser.isActive });
      setUsers((current) =>
        current.map((item) => item.id === managedUser.id ? { ...item, isActive: !item.isActive } : item),
      );
      toast.success(managedUser.isActive ? 'Acceso desactivado.' : 'Acceso activado.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al cambiar acceso', error);
      toast.error('No se pudo cambiar el acceso.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge"><Users size={24} /></div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Usuarios</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Administra personal, clientes y accesos.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)} className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white btn-primary">
          <Plus size={18} /> Nuevo usuario
        </button>
      </header>

      <div className="glass overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
        {isLoading ? <p className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">Cargando usuarios...</p> : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-white/5 text-left">
              <thead className="bg-white/[0.03] text-xs uppercase text-slate-400"><tr><th className="px-6 py-4">Usuario</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Rol</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Estado</th><th className="px-6 py-4">Acción</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                {users.map((managedUser) => (
                  <tr key={managedUser.id} className="hover:bg-white/5">
                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><div className="font-medium text-white">{managedUser.name}</div><div className="text-sm text-slate-400">{managedUser.email}</div></td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-300">{managedUser.role}</td>
                    <td className={`px-6 py-4 ${managedUser.isActive ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><ShieldCheck size={16} />{managedUser.isActive ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo'}</span></td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4"><button type="button" onClick={() => void toggleActive(managedUser)} className="text-sm font-medium text-brand-400 hover:text-brand-300">{managedUser.isActive ? 'Desactivar' : 'Activar'}</button></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-center p-4 glass-overlay">
          <form onSubmit={createUser} className="glass-strong w-full max-w-lg space-y-4 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between"><h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Crear usuario</h3><button type="button" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)} aria-label="Cerrar"><X /></button></div>
            {(['name', 'email', 'password'] as const).map((field) => (
              <input key={field} required value={form[field]} type={field === 'password' ? 'password' : field === 'email' ? 'email' : 'text'} placeholder={field === 'name' ? 'Nombre completo' : field === 'email' ? 'Correo electrónico' : 'Contraseña'} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, [field]: event.target.value })} className="w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white glass-input" />
            ))}
            <select value={form.role} onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, role: event.target.value as Role })} className="w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white glass-input">
              {roles.map((role) => <option key={role} value={role}>{role}</option>)}
            </select>
            {form.role === 'PROVEEDOR' && (
              <input
                required
                min={1}
                type="number"
                value={form.supplierId}
                placeholder="ID del proveedor"
                onChange={(event) => setForm({ ...form, supplierId: event.target.value })}
                className="w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white glass-input"
              />
            )}
            <button disabled={saving} className="w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50 btn-primary">{saving ? 'Guardando...' : 'Crear usuario'}</button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Users/UsersManagement.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { ShieldCheck, Users, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../../api/axios';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

interface ManagedUser {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  email: string;
  role: Role;
  isActive: boolean;
}

const roles: Role[] = [
  'GERENTE',
  'MECANICO',
  'BODEGUERO',
  'CONTADOR',
  'CLIENTE',
  'PROVEEDOR',
];

export default function UsersManagement() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<ManagedUser[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [updatingUserId, setUpdatingUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.role !== 'GERENTE') {
      return;
    }

    const loadUsers = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get<ManagedUser[]>('/auth/users');
        setUsers(response.data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar los usuarios', error);
        toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los usuarios.');
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadUsers();
  }, [user?.role]);

  if (user?.role !== 'GERENTE') {
    return <Navigate to="/dashboard" replace />;
  }

  const updateRole = async (id: number, role: Role) => {
    const previousUser = users.find((managedUser) => managedUser.id === id);
    if (!previousUser) {
      return;
    }

    setUpdatingUserId(id);
    setUsers((currentUsers) =>
      currentUsers.map((managedUser) =>
        managedUser.id === id ? { ...managedUser, role } : managedUser,
      ),
    );

    try {
      await api.patch(`/auth/users/${id}/role`, { role });
      toast.success('Rol actualizado correctamente.');
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al actualizar el rol', error);
      setUsers((currentUsers) =>
        currentUsers.map((managedUser) =>
          managedUser.id === id ? previousUser : managedUser,
        ),
      );
      toast.error('No se pudo actualizar el rol.');
    } finally {
      setUpdatingUserId(null);
    }
  };

  const toggleActive = async (managedUser: ManagedUser) => {
    setUpdatingUserId(managedUser.id);
    setUsers((currentUsers) =>
      currentUsers.map((currentUser) =>
        currentUser.id === managedUser.id
          ? { ...currentUser, isActive: !managedUser.isActive }
          : currentUser,
      ),
    );

    try {
      await api.patch(`/auth/users/${managedUser.id}/toggle`, {
        isActive: !managedUser.isActive,
      });
      toast.success(
        managedUser.isActive
          ? 'Usuario desactivado correctamente.'
          : 'Usuario activado correctamente.',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error al actualizar el estado del usuario', error);
      setUsers((currentUsers) =>
        currentUsers.map((currentUser) =>
          currentUser.id === managedUser.id ? managedUser : currentUser,
        ),
      );
      toast.error('No se pudo actualizar el estado del usuario.');
    } finally {
      setUpdatingUserId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge">
          <Users size={24} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Gestión de usuarios</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
            Administra el acceso y los roles de los usuarios registrados.
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="glass overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-16">
            <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-400" size={28} />
          </div>
        ) : users.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-400">
            No hay usuarios registrados.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-white/5">
              <thead className="bg-white/[0.03]">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                    Usuario
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                    Rol
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 text-left text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
                    Estado
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                {users.map((managedUser) => {
                  const isUpdating = updatingUserId === managedUser.id;

                  return (
                    <tr key={managedUser.id} className="hover:bg-white/5">
                      <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-6 py-4">
                        <div className="font-medium text-white">{managedUser.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-sm text-slate-400">{managedUser.email}</div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={`role-${managedUser.id}`}>
                          Rol de {managedUser.name}
                        </label>
                        <select
                          id={`role-${managedUser.id}`}
                          value={managedUser.role}
                          disabled={isUpdating}
                          onChange={(event) =>
                            void updateRole(managedUser.id, event.target.value as Role)
                          }
                          className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 glass-input"
                        >
                          {roles.map((role) => (
                            <option key={role} value={role}>
                              {role}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          role="switch"
                          aria-checked={managedUser.isActive}
                          aria-label={`${managedUser.isActive ? 'Desactivar' : 'Activar'} a ${managedUser.name}`}
                          disabled={isUpdating}
                          onClick={() => void toggleActive(managedUser)}
                          className={`relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 items-center rounded-full transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 ${
                            managedUser.isActive ? 'bg-brand-500' : 'bg-slate-600'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`inline-block h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-white transition-transform ${
                              managedUser.isActive ? 'translate-x-6' : 'translate-x-1'
                            }`}
                          />
                        </button>
                        <span
                          className={`ml-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm ${
                            managedUser.isActive ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-slate-400'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <ShieldCheck size={15} />
                          {managedUser.isActive ? 'Activo' : 'Inactivo'}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/NewWorkOrderModal.tsx
