import { FormEvent, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ClipboardPlus, Loader2, X } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { usersApi, vehiclesApi, workOrdersApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { AppUser, CreateWorkOrderPayload, Vehicle, WorkOrder } from '../../api/types';
import { useAuth } from '../../contexts/AuthContext';

interface NewWorkOrderModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: (order: WorkOrder) => void;
}

interface FormState {
  vehicleId: string;
  description: string;
  mileage: string;
  estimatedCost: string;
  mechanicId: string;
}

const EMPTY_FORM: FormState = { vehicleId: '', description: '', mileage: '', estimatedCost: '', mechanicId: '' };

const fieldClass =
  'w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white disabled:opacity-50 glass-input';

/** Formulario de nueva OT. El código OT-YYYY-NNN lo asigna el backend. */
export default function NewWorkOrderModal({ onClose, onCreated }: NewWorkOrderModalProps) {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const isManager = user?.role === 'GERENTE';
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY_FORM);
  const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState<Vehicle[]>([]);
  const [mechanics, setMechanics] = useState<AppUser[]>([]);
  const [isLoadingOptions, setIsLoadingOptions] = useState(true);
  const [optionsError, setOptionsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const [vehicleList, userList] = await Promise.all([
          vehiclesApi.list(),
          // Solo el GERENTE puede listar usuarios y asignar a otro mecánico.
          isManager ? usersApi.list() : Promise.resolve<AppUser[]>([]),
        ]);
        if (!active) return;
        setVehicles(vehicleList);
        setMechanics(userList.filter((item) => item.role === 'MECANICO' && item.isActive));
      } catch (error) {
        if (active) setOptionsError(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudieron cargar vehículos y mecánicos.'));
      } finally {
        if (active) setIsLoadingOptions(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [isManager]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape' && !isSaving) onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [isSaving, onClose]);

  const update = (field: keyof FormState, value: string) => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));

  const validate = (): string | null => {
    if (!form.vehicleId) return 'Selecciona un vehículo.';
    if (!form.description.trim()) return 'Describe el motivo de ingreso.';
    if (form.mileage && (!Number.isInteger(Number(form.mileage)) || Number(form.mileage) < 0)) {
      return 'El kilometraje debe ser un número entero positivo.';
    }
    if (form.estimatedCost && (Number.isNaN(Number(form.estimatedCost)) || Number(form.estimatedCost) < 0)) {
      return 'El costo estimado debe ser un monto positivo.';
    }
    return null;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const validationError = validate();
    if (validationError) {
      toast.error(validationError);
      return;
    }

    const payload: CreateWorkOrderPayload = {
      vehicleId: Number(form.vehicleId),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      ...(form.mileage && { mileage: Number(form.mileage) }),
      ...(form.estimatedCost && { estimatedCost: Number(form.estimatedCost) }),
      ...(form.mechanicId && { mechanicId: Number(form.mechanicId) }),
    };

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const order = await workOrdersApi.create(payload);
      toast.success(`Orden ${order.number} creada.`);
      onCreated(order);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo crear la orden.'));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 glass-overlay"
      onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && !isSaving && onClose()}
    >
      <form
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="new-work-order-title"
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="glass-strong w-full max-w-lg space-y-5 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-2xl"
      >
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="rounded-xl p-2.5 icon-badge">
              <ClipboardPlus size={20} />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 id="new-work-order-title" className="text-lg font-bold text-white">Nueva orden de trabajo</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">El código OT-AAAA-NNN se asigna automáticamente.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar" className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-white">
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </header>

        {optionsError && <p className="rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-red-500/10 p-3 text-sm text-red-300">{optionsError}</p>}

        <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
          Vehículo *
          <select
            autoFocus
            required
            disabled={isLoadingOptions}
            value={form.vehicleId}
            onChange={(event) => update('vehicleId', event.target.value)}
            className={fieldClass}
          >
            <option value="">{isLoadingOptions ? 'Cargando vehículos…' : 'Selecciona un vehículo'}</option>
            {vehicles.map((vehicle) => (
              <option key={vehicle.id} value={vehicle.id}>
                {vehicle.plate} · {vehicle.make} {vehicle.model}
                {vehicle.owner ? ` — ${vehicle.owner.name}` : ''}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>

        <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
          Motivo de ingreso *
          <textarea
            required
            rows={3}
            maxLength={2000}
            value={form.description}
            onChange={(event) => update('description', event.target.value)}
            placeholder="Ej.: ruido al frenar, revisión de 10.000 km…"
            className={fieldClass}
          />
        </label>

        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
            Kilometraje
            <input
              type="number"
              min={0}
              step={1}
              inputMode="numeric"
              value={form.mileage}
              onChange={(event) => update('mileage', event.target.value)}
              placeholder="85400"
              className={fieldClass}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
            Costo estimado
            <input
              type="number"
              min={0}
              step="0.01"
              inputMode="decimal"
              value={form.estimatedCost}
              onChange={(event) => update('estimatedCost', event.target.value)}
              placeholder="0.00"
              className={fieldClass}
            />
          </label>
        </div>

        {isManager ? (
          <label className="block space-y-1.5 text-sm text-slate-300">
            Mecánico asignado
            <select
              disabled={isLoadingOptions}
              value={form.mechanicId}
              onChange={(event) => update('mechanicId', event.target.value)}
              className={fieldClass}
            >
              <option value="">Sin asignar</option>
              {mechanics.map((mechanic) => (
                <option key={mechanic.id} value={mechanic.id}>{mechanic.name}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
        ) : (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">La orden quedará asignada a ti.</p>
        )}

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={isSaving}
            className="rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 btn-secondary"
          >
            Cancelar
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isSaving || isLoadingOptions}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50 btn-primary"
          >
            {isSaving && <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" />}
            Crear orden
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/PartAutocomplete.tsx
================
import { FormEvent, KeyboardEvent, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Loader2, PackagePlus, Search, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { inventoryApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { InventoryPart } from '../../api/types';

const MIN_QUERY_LENGTH = 2;
const DEBOUNCE_MS = 250;

interface PartAutocompleteProps {
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Debe lanzar si falla, para conservar la selección y mostrar el error. */
  onAdd: (part: InventoryPart, quantity: number) => Promise<void>;
}

/** Buscador de piezas del inventario + cantidad para agregarlas a una OT. */
export default function PartAutocomplete({ disabled = false, onAdd }: PartAutocompleteProps) {
  const listboxId = useId();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [results, setResults] = useState<InventoryPart[]>([]);
  const [isSearching, setIsSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searchError, setSearchError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(-1);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<InventoryPart | null>(null);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState('1');
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const latestRequest = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const term = query.trim();
    if (selected || term.length < MIN_QUERY_LENGTH) {
      latestRequest.current += 1;
      setResults([]);
      setIsSearching(false);
      setSearchError(null);
      return;
    }

    const requestId = ++latestRequest.current;
    setIsSearching(true);
    setSearchError(null);
    const timer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
      try {
        const parts = await inventoryApi.searchParts(term);
        if (requestId !== latestRequest.current) return; // respuesta obsoleta
        setResults(parts);
        setActiveIndex(parts.findIndex((part) => part.quantity > 0));
        setIsOpen(true);
      } catch (error) {
        if (requestId === latestRequest.current) {
          setSearchError(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo buscar en el inventario.'));
        }
      } finally {
        if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setIsSearching(false);
      }
    }, DEBOUNCE_MS);

    return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [query, selected]);

  const choose = (part: InventoryPart) => {
    if (part.quantity <= 0) return;
    setSelected(part);
    setQuery(`${part.name} (${part.code})`);
    setQuantity('1');
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  const clearSelection = () => {
    setSelected(null);
    setQuery('');
    setQuantity('1');
  };

  const moveActive = (step: 1 | -1) => {
    if (results.length === 0) return;
    let next = activeIndex;
    for (let i = 0; i < results.length; i += 1) {
      next = (next + step + results.length) % results.length;
      if (results[next].quantity > 0) break;
    }
    setActiveIndex(next);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!isOpen) return;
    if (event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
      event.preventDefault();
      moveActive(1);
    } else if (event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
      event.preventDefault();
      moveActive(-1);
    } else if (event.key === 'Enter' && activeIndex >= 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      choose(results[activeIndex]);
    } else if (event.key === 'Escape') {
      event.stopPropagation(); // cierra solo la lista, no el panel que la contiene
      setIsOpen(false);
    }
  };

  const parsedQuantity = Number(quantity);
  const quantityError =
    selected && (!Number.isInteger(parsedQuantity) || parsedQuantity < 1)
      ? 'Ingresa una cantidad entera mayor a 0.'
      : selected && parsedQuantity > selected.quantity
        ? `Solo hay ${selected.quantity} en stock.`
        : null;

  const handleSubmit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!selected || quantityError) return;
    setIsAdding(true);
    try {
      await onAdd(selected, parsedQuantity);
      clearSelection();
    } catch {
      // El padre ya notificó el error; se conserva la selección para corregir.
    } finally {
      setIsAdding(false);
    }
  };

  const showList = isOpen && !selected && query.trim().length >= MIN_QUERY_LENGTH;

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3">
      <div className="relative">
        <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
        <input
          type="text"
          role="combobox"
          aria-expanded={showList}
          aria-controls={listboxId}
          aria-autocomplete="list"
          aria-activedescendant={showList && activeIndex >= 0 ? `${listboxId}-${activeIndex}` : undefined}
          aria-label="Buscar repuesto por nombre o código"
          disabled={disabled || isAdding}
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => {
            if (selected) setSelected(null);
            setQuery(event.target.value);
          }}
          onFocus={() => results.length > 0 && setIsOpen(true)}
          onBlur={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          placeholder="Buscar repuesto por nombre o código…"
          className="w-full rounded-xl py-2.5 pl-9 pr-9 text-sm text-white disabled:opacity-50 glass-input"
        />
        {isSearching ? (
          <Loader2 size={16} className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 animate-spin text-brand-400" />
        ) : (
          (query || selected) && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={clearSelection}
              aria-label="Limpiar búsqueda"
              className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1 text-slate-500 hover:text-white"
            >
              <X size={15} />
            </button>
          )
        )}

        {showList && (
          <ul
            id={listboxId}
            role="listbox"
            className="glass absolute z-20 mt-2 max-h-72 w-full overflow-y-auto rounded-xl p-1 shadow-2xl"
          >
            {results.length === 0 ? (
              <li className="px-3 py-3 text-sm text-slate-400">Sin coincidencias en el inventario.</li>
            ) : (
              results.map((part, index) => {
                const outOfStock = part.quantity <= 0;
                return (
                  <li
                    key={part.id}
                    id={`${listboxId}-${index}`}
                    role="option"
                    aria-selected={index === activeIndex}
                    aria-disabled={outOfStock}
                    onMouseDown={(event) => event.preventDefault()}
                    onMouseEnter={() => !outOfStock && setActiveIndex(index)}
                    onClick={() => choose(part)}
                    className={`flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm ${
                      outOfStock
                        ? 'cursor-not-allowed opacity-50'
                        : index === activeIndex
                          ? 'cursor-pointer bg-brand-500/15 text-white'
                          : 'cursor-pointer text-slate-200 hover:bg-white/5'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="min-w-0">
                      <span className="block truncate font-medium">{part.name}</span>
                      <span className="block truncate text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {part.code}
                        {part.box && ` · ${part.box.name}`}
                      </span>
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`shrink-0 text-xs font-medium ${
                        outOfStock ? 'text-red-400' : part.quantity <= part.minStock ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-emerald-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {outOfStock ? 'Sin stock' : `${part.quantity} disp.`}
                    </span>
                  </li>
                );
              })
            )}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>

      {searchError && <p className="text-xs text-red-400">{searchError}</p>}

      {selected && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 rounded-xl border border-brand-500/30 bg-brand-500/5 p-3">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
            Cantidad
            <input
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={selected.quantity}
              step={1}
              value={quantity}
              onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
              className="w-24 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white glass-input"
            />
          </label>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={isAdding || quantityError !== null}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 btn-primary"
          >
            {isAdding ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <PackagePlus size={16} />}
            Agregar a la OT
          </button>
          <p className={`w-full text-xs ${quantityError ? 'text-amber-400' : 'text-slate-500'}`}>
            {quantityError ?? `Se descontará del inventario al agregar (stock actual: ${selected.quantity}).`}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </form>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/WorkOrderDetailPanel.tsx
================
import { ReactNode, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Car,
  CheckCircle2,
  ClipboardList,
  Gauge,
  Loader2,
  Package,
  Play,
  Save,
  Stethoscope,
  Trash2,
  User,
  Wrench,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { workOrderActionsApi, workOrdersApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { InventoryPart, WorkOrder } from '../../api/types';
import { EMPTY, formatCurrency, formatDateTime } from '../../utils/format';
import { WORK_ORDER_STATUS } from '../../utils/status';
import StatusBadge from '../ui/StatusBadge';
import PartAutocomplete from './PartAutocomplete';
import { WORK_ORDER_TRANSITIONS } from './workOrderFlow';

interface WorkOrderDetailPanelProps {
  order: WorkOrder;
  onClose: () => void;
  onUpdated: (order: WorkOrder) => void;
}

const kmFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('es');

function Section({ icon, title, children }: { icon: ReactNode; title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="glass rounded-2xl p-4">
      <h4 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400">
        <span className="text-brand-400">{icon}</span>
        {title}
      </h4>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function Field({ label, value }: { label: string; value: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <dt className="text-xs text-slate-500">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="text-sm text-slate-200">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Panel lateral con el detalle de una OT, su flujo de estados y los repuestos utilizados. */
export default function WorkOrderDetailPanel({ order, onClose, onUpdated }: WorkOrderDetailPanelProps) {
  const [diagnosis, setDiagnosis] = useState(order.diagnosis ?? '');
  const [finalCost, setFinalCost] = useState(order.estimatedCost ?? '');
  const [busyAction, setBusyAction] = useState<'status' | 'diagnosis' | 'conclude' | null>(null);

  const isConcluded = order.status === 'CONCLUIDO';
  const transition = WORK_ORDER_TRANSITIONS[order.status];
  const parts = order.parts ?? [];
  const totalUnits = parts.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') onClose();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  const runAction = async (action: NonNullable<typeof busyAction>, task: () => Promise<WorkOrder>, success: string) => {
    setBusyAction(action);
    try {
      onUpdated(await task());
      toast.success(success);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo actualizar la orden.'));
    } finally {
      setBusyAction(null);
    }
  };

  const changeStatus = () => {
    if (!transition) return;
    void runAction(
      'status',
      () => workOrdersApi.update(order.id, { status: transition.to }),
      `Orden en "${WORK_ORDER_STATUS[transition.to].label}".`,
    );
  };

  const saveDiagnosis = () =>
    void runAction('diagnosis', () => workOrdersApi.update(order.id, { diagnosis: diagnosis.trim() }), 'Diagnóstico guardado.');

  const conclude = () => {
    const cost = finalCost === '' ? undefined : Number(finalCost);
    if (cost !== undefined && (Number.isNaN(cost) || cost < 0)) {
      toast.error('El costo final debe ser un monto positivo.');
      return;
    }
    if (!window.confirm(`¿Concluir la orden ${order.number}? Ya no podrá modificarse.`)) return;
    void runAction(
      'conclude',
      async () => {
        await workOrderActionsApi.conclude(order.id, cost);
        // /close responde sin mecánico ni factura: se recarga el detalle completo.
        return workOrdersApi.get(order.id);
      },
      `Orden ${order.number} concluida.`,
    );
  };

  const [removingPartId, setRemovingPartId] = useState<number | null>(null);

  const removePart = async (partId: number, name: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm(`¿Quitar "${name}" de la orden? Su cantidad vuelve al inventario.`)) return;
    setRemovingPartId(partId);
    try {
      onUpdated(await workOrderActionsApi.removeUsedPart(order.id, partId));
      toast.success(`"${name}" quitado; stock devuelto.`);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo quitar el repuesto.'));
    } finally {
      setRemovingPartId(null);
    }
  };

  const partsTotal = parts.reduce(
    (sum, item) => (item.unitPrice === null ? sum : sum + Number(item.unitPrice) * item.quantity),
    0,
  );

  /** Lanza en error para que el buscador conserve la selección. */
  const addPart = async (part: InventoryPart, quantity: number) => {
    try {
      onUpdated(await workOrderActionsApi.addUsedPart(order.id, { partId: part.id, quantity }));
      toast.success(`${quantity} × ${part.name} agregado(s); stock descontado.`);
    } catch (error) {
      toast.error(getApiErrorMessage(error, 'No se pudo agregar el repuesto.'));
      throw error;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex justify-end">
      <div className="glass-overlay absolute inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />

      <aside
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="work-order-detail-title"
        className="glass-strong relative flex h-full w-full max-w-xl flex-col rounded-l-2xl"
      >
        <header className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-white/10 p-5">
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">Orden de trabajo</p>
            <h3 id="work-order-detail-title" className="mt-1 text-2xl font-bold text-white">{order.number}</h3>
            <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <StatusBadge {...WORK_ORDER_STATUS[order.status]} />
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">Creada {formatDateTime(order.createdAt)}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button type="button" onClick={onClose} aria-label="Cerrar detalle" className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white">
            <X size={22} />
          </button>
        </header>

        <div className="flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto p-5">
          {!isConcluded && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-brand-500/20 bg-brand-500/5 p-4">
              {transition && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={changeStatus}
                  disabled={busyAction !== null}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50 btn-primary"
                >
                  {busyAction === 'status' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <Play size={16} />}
                  {transition.label}
                </button>
              )}
              <div className="ml-auto flex items-end gap-2">
                <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-xs text-slate-400">
                  Costo final
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min={0}
                    step="0.01"
                    value={finalCost}
                    onChange={(event) => setFinalCost(event.target.value)}
                    placeholder="0.00"
                    className="w-28 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white glass-input"
                  />
                </label>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={conclude}
                  disabled={busyAction !== null}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-emerald-500/40 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-emerald-400 hover:bg-emerald-500/10 disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  {busyAction === 'conclude' ? <Loader2 size={16} className="animate-spin" /> : <CheckCircle2 size={16} />}
                  Concluir
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <Section icon={<Car size={16} />} title="Vehículo">
            {order.vehicle ? (
              <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <Field label="Placa" value={<span className="font-mono font-semibold text-white">{order.vehicle.plate}</span>} />
                <Field label="Marca / modelo" value={`${order.vehicle.make} ${order.vehicle.model}`} />
                <Field label="Año" value={order.vehicle.year ?? EMPTY} />
                <Field label="Color" value={order.vehicle.color ?? EMPTY} />
                <Field
                  label="Kilometraje de ingreso"
                  value={
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Gauge size={14} className="text-slate-500" />
                      {order.mileage === null ? EMPTY : `${kmFormatter.format(order.mileage)} km`}
                    </span>
                  }
                />
                <Field label="VIN" value={order.vehicle.vin ?? EMPTY} />
                <div className="col-span-2 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl p-3 glass-inset">
                  <User size={16} className="text-slate-500" />
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-200">{order.vehicle.owner?.name ?? EMPTY}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{order.vehicle.owner?.email}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </dl>
            ) : (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Sin datos del vehículo.</p>
            )}
          </Section>

          <Section icon={<ClipboardList size={16} />} title="Servicio">
            <p className="mb-3 whitespace-pre-line text-sm text-slate-200">{order.description}</p>
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <Field
                label="Mecánico"
                value={
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Wrench size={14} className="text-slate-500" />
                    {order.mechanic?.name ?? 'Sin asignar'}
                  </span>
                }
              />
              <Field label="Iniciada" value={formatDateTime(order.startedAt)} />
              <Field label="Costo estimado" value={formatCurrency(order.estimatedCost)} />
              <Field label="Costo final" value={formatCurrency(order.finalCost)} />
              {isConcluded && <Field label="Concluida" value={formatDateTime(order.completedAt)} />}
            </dl>
          </Section>

          <Section icon={<Stethoscope size={16} />} title="Diagnóstico">
            {isConcluded ? (
              <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm text-slate-200">{order.diagnosis || 'Sin diagnóstico registrado.'}</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <textarea
                  rows={3}
                  value={diagnosis}
                  onChange={(event) => setDiagnosis(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Hallazgos técnicos de la revisión…"
                  className="w-full rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white glass-input"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={saveDiagnosis}
                  disabled={busyAction !== null || diagnosis.trim() === (order.diagnosis ?? '').trim()}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-slate-200 disabled:opacity-40 btn-secondary"
                >
                  {busyAction === 'diagnosis' ? <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" /> : <Save size={15} />}
                  Guardar diagnóstico
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </Section>

          <Section icon={<Package size={16} />} title="Repuestos utilizados">
            {parts.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="mb-4 text-sm text-slate-400">Aún no se registran repuestos.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="mb-4 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-white/5 text-sm">
                  <thead className="bg-white/[0.03] text-xs uppercase text-slate-400">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-3 py-2 text-left font-semibold">Repuesto</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold">Cant.</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold">P. unit.</th>
                      {!isConcluded && <th className="px-3 py-2"><span className="sr-only">Quitar</span></th>}
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                    {parts.map((item) => (
                      <tr key={item.id} className="text-slate-300">
                        <td className="px-3 py-2">
                          <div className="text-slate-100">{item.part?.name ?? `Pieza #${item.partId}`}</div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">{item.part?.code}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold text-white">{item.quantity}</td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right text-slate-300">{formatCurrency(item.unitPrice)}</td>
                        {!isConcluded && (
                          <td className="px-2 py-2 text-right">
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => void removePart(item.partId, item.part?.name ?? `Pieza #${item.partId}`)}
                              disabled={removingPartId !== null}
                              title="Quitar repuesto (devuelve stock)"
                              aria-label={`Quitar ${item.part?.name ?? 'repuesto'}`}
                              className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400 disabled:opacity-40"
                            >
                              {removingPartId === item.partId ? <Loader2 size={15} className="animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 size={15} />}
                            </button>
                          </td>
                        )}
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                  <tfoot className="bg-white/[0.03] text-xs text-slate-400">
                    <tr>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2">{parts.length} repuesto(s)</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right">{totalUnits} u.</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-2 text-right font-semibold text-slate-200">{formatCurrency(partsTotal)}</td>
                      {!isConcluded && <td />}
                    </tr>
                  </tfoot>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}

            {isConcluded ? (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">La orden está concluida: no admite más repuestos.</p>
            ) : (
              <PartAutocomplete onAdd={addPart} />
            )}
          </Section>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/WorkOrders/WorkOrdersList.tsx

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  AlertCircle,
  ClipboardList,
  Gauge,
  Package,
  Plus,
  RotateCw,
  Search,
  Wrench,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { getApiErrorMessage } from '../../api/errors';
import { workOrdersApi } from '../../api/resources';
import type { WorkOrder, WorkOrderStatus } from '../../api/types';
import { formatDate } from '../../utils/format';
import { WORK_ORDER_STATUS } from '../../utils/status';
import NewWorkOrderModal from './NewWorkOrderModal';
import WorkOrderDetailPanel from './WorkOrderDetailPanel';
import { WORK_ORDER_COLUMNS } from './workOrderFlow';

const columnAccent: Record<WorkOrderStatus, string> = {
  EN_DIAGNOSTICO: 'bg-sky-400',
  EN_PROCESO: 'bg-brand-500',
  ESPERA_REPUESTOS: 'bg-amber-400',
  CONCLUIDO: 'bg-emerald-400',
};

const kmFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('es');

function matchesFilter(order: WorkOrder, term: string): boolean {
  if (!term) return true;
  const haystack = [
    order.number,
    order.description,
    order.vehicle?.plate,
    order.vehicle?.make,
    order.vehicle?.model,
    order.vehicle?.owner?.name,
    order.mechanic?.name,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ')
    .toLowerCase();
  return haystack.includes(term);
}

function OrderCard({ order, onOpen }: { order: WorkOrder; onOpen: () => void }) {
  const partsCount = order.parts?.length ?? 0;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onOpen}
      className="glass-inset glass-hover group w-full rounded-xl p-4 text-left"
    >
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div>
          <p className="font-bold text-white group-hover:text-brand-300">{order.number}</p>
          <p className="font-mono text-sm text-brand-400">{order.vehicle?.plate}</p>
        </div>
        <span className="text-right text-xs text-slate-500">
          {order.vehicle?.make} {order.vehicle?.model}
        </span>
      </div>
      <p className="mt-3 line-clamp-2 text-sm text-slate-300">{order.description}</p>
      <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 border-t border-white/10 pt-3 text-xs text-slate-400">
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <Wrench size={13} /> {order.mechanic?.name ?? 'Sin asignar'}
        </span>
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
          <Package size={13} /> {partsCount}
        </span>
        {order.mileage !== null && (
          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">
            <Gauge size={13} /> {kmFormatter.format(order.mileage)} km
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="ml-auto">{formatDate(order.createdAt)}</span>
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

/**
 * Tablero Kanban de órdenes de trabajo por estado, con alta de nuevas OT y
 * panel lateral de detalle (flujo de estados, diagnóstico y repuestos).
 * El backend limita al MECANICO a sus órdenes asignadas.
 */
export default function WorkOrdersList() {
  const [orders, setOrders] = useState<WorkOrder[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('');
  const [isCreating, setIsCreating] = useState(false);
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const latestRequest = useRef(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++latestRequest.current;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const data = await workOrdersApi.list();
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setOrders(data);
    } catch (loadError) {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) {
        setError(getApiErrorMessage(loadError, 'No se pudieron cargar las órdenes de trabajo.'));
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === latestRequest.current) setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
    return () => {
      latestRequest.current += 1;
    };
  }, [load]);

  const term = filter.trim().toLowerCase();
  const columns = useMemo(
    () =>
      WORK_ORDER_COLUMNS.map((status) => ({
        status,
        orders: orders.filter((order) => order.status === status && matchesFilter(order, term)),
      })),
    [orders, term],
  );

  const selectedOrder = orders.find((order) => order.id === selectedId) ?? null;

  const upsertOrder = useCallback((updated: WorkOrder) => {
    setOrders((current) =>
      current.some((order) => order.id === updated.id)
        ? current.map((order) => (order.id === updated.id ? updated : order))
        : [updated, ...current],
    );
  }, []);

  const closeDetail = useCallback(() => setSelectedId(null), []);
  const closeCreate = useCallback(() => setIsCreating(false), []);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge">
            <ClipboardList size={24} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Órdenes de trabajo</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
              Flujo del taller por estado
              {!isLoading && !error && <span className="text-slate-500"> · {orders.length} órdenes</span>}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500" />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={filter}
              onChange={(event) => setFilter(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Filtrar por OT, placa, cliente…"
              aria-label="Filtrar órdenes"
              className="glass w-full rounded-xl py-2.5 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-white placeholder:text-slate-500 outline-none focus:border-brand-500 sm:w-72"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsCreating(true)}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(249,115,22,0.25)] focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand-300 btn-primary"
          >
            <Plus size={18} /> Nueva Orden
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {error && !isLoading ? (
        <div className="glass flex flex-col items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl p-10 text-center">
          <AlertCircle className="text-red-400" size={28} />
          <p className="text-slate-300">{error}</p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void load()}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-200 btn-secondary"
          >
            <RotateCw size={16} /> Reintentar
          </button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-5 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
          {columns.map(({ status, orders: columnOrders }) => (
            <div
              key={status}
              className="glass flex flex-col rounded-2xl p-4"
            >
              <h3 className="mb-4 flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-slate-200">
                <span className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full ${columnAccent[status]}`} />
                {WORK_ORDER_STATUS[status].label}
                <span className="ml-auto rounded-full bg-white/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-slate-300">
                  {isLoading ? '…' : columnOrders.length}
                </span>
              </h3>

              <div className="space-y-3" aria-busy={isLoading}>
                {isLoading &&
                  Array.from({ length: 2 }, (_, index) => (
                    <div key={index} className="h-32 animate-pulse rounded-xl glass-inset" />
                  ))}
                {!isLoading && columnOrders.length === 0 && (
                  <p className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-white/10 p-4 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {term ? 'Sin coincidencias' : 'Sin órdenes'}
                  </p>
                )}
                {!isLoading &&
                  columnOrders.map((order) => (
                    <OrderCard key={order.id} order={order} onOpen={() => setSelectedId(order.id)} />
                  ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {isCreating && (
        <NewWorkOrderModal
          onClose={closeCreate}
          onCreated={(order) => {
            upsertOrder(order);
            setIsCreating(false);
            setSelectedId(order.id);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {selectedOrder && (
        <WorkOrderDetailPanel
          key={selectedOrder.id}
          order={selectedOrder}
          onClose={closeDetail}
          onUpdated={upsertOrder}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/AuditLogs.tsx
================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { ClipboardList, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';
import api from '../api/axios';

interface AuditLog {
  id: number;
  query: string;
  found: boolean;
  alexaResponse: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
}

export default function AuditLogs() {
  const [logs, setLogs] = useState<AuditLog[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadLogs = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get<AuditLog[]>('/logs');
        setLogs(response.data);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error al cargar los logs de auditoría', error);
        toast.error('No se pudieron cargar los registros de auditoría.');
      } finally {
        setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void loadLogs();
  }, []);

  return (
    <section className="space-y-6">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="rounded-xl p-3 icon-badge">
          <ClipboardList size={24} />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">Auditoría de búsquedas</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">
            Últimas búsquedas realizadas mediante Alexa.
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="glass overflow-hidden rounded-2xl">
        {isLoading ? (
          <div className="flex justify-center p-8">
            <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-brand-400" size={28} />
          </div>
        ) : logs.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">
            No hay registros de búsquedas.
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full min-w-[760px] text-left text-sm">
              <thead className="border-b border-white/10 bg-white/[0.03]">
                <tr>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Fecha</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">
                    Query pronunciado
                  </th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">Estado</th>
                  <th className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-300">
                    Respuesta de Alexa
                  </th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5">
                {logs.map((log) => (
                  <tr key={log.id} className="transition-colors hover:bg-white/5">
                    <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-6 py-4 text-slate-400">
                      {new Date(log.createdAt).toLocaleString('es-ES')}
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium text-white">{log.query}</td>
                    <td className="px-6 py-4">
                      <span
                        className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold ${
                          log.found
                            ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400'
                            : 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-400'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {log.found ? 'Encontrado' : 'No Encontrado'}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="max-w-md px-6 py-4 text-slate-400">
                      {log.alexaResponse ?? 'Sin respuesta registrada'}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/components/Login.tsx
================
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import api from '../api/axios';
import { Wrench } from 'lucide-react';
import toast from 'react-hot-toast';

export default function Login() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('gerente@geartrace.com');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('password123');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const { login } = useAuth();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      const response = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
      toast.success(`Bienvenido, ${response.data.user.name}`);
      login(response.data.accessToken, response.data.user);
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.response?.data?.message || 'Error al iniciar sesión');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center py-12 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 relative overflow-hidden">
      {/* Elemento de diseño de fondo (glow) */}
      <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-96 h-96 bg-brand-500 rounded-full blur-[128px] opacity-20 pointer-events-none"></div>

      <div className="glass-strong max-w-md w-full space-y-8 p-10 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl relative z-10">
        <div>
          <div className="icon-badge mx-auto h-16 w-16 flex items-center justify-center rounded-2xl">
            <Wrench size={32} strokeWidth={2.5} />
          </div>
          <h2 className="mt-6 text-center text-3xl font-extrabold text-white">
            GearTrace
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-2 text-center text-sm text-slate-400">
            Sistema de Gestión Logística Inteligente
          </p>
        </div>
        
        <form className="mt-8 space-y-6" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <div className="space-y-4 rounded-md shadow-sm">
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email-address" className="sr-only">Correo electrónico</label>
              <input
                id="email-address"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                required
                className="appearance-none rounded-xl relative block w-full px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:z-10 sm:text-sm transition-all glass-input"
                placeholder="Correo electrónico"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="password" className="sr-only">Contraseña</label>
              <input
                id="password"
                name="password"
                type="password"
                required
                className="appearance-none rounded-xl relative block w-full px-4 py-3 text-white placeholder-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:z-10 sm:text-sm transition-all glass-input"
                placeholder="Contraseña"
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="group relative w-full flex justify-center py-3 px-4 text-sm font-semibold rounded-xl btn-primary focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-brand-500 focus:ring-offset-slate-900 transition-all disabled:opacity-70 disabled:cursor-not-allowed shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,88,12,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(249,115,22,0.6)]"
            >
              {loading ? (
                <div className="h-5 w-5 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
              ) : (
                'Iniciar Sesión'
              )}
            </button>
          </div>
          
          <div className="text-center text-xs text-slate-500 mt-4 space-y-1">
            <p>Demo accounts (pass: password123):</p>
            <p>gerente@geartrace.com | mecanico@... | cliente@...</p>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx

import { NavLink } from 'react-router-dom';
import {
  CalendarDays,
  Car,
  ClipboardList,
  History,
  LayoutDashboard,
  LogOut,
  Package,
  Receipt,
  ShoppingCart,
  Truck,
  Users,
  Wrench,
  X,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Role, useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { ROUTE_ROLES } from '../routes/routeRoles';
import { ROLE_META } from '../utils/status';

export interface NavigationItem {
  label: string;
  path: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  roles: readonly Role[];
  section: NavigationSection;
}

type NavigationSection = 'General' | 'Servicio técnico' | 'Abastecimiento' | 'Administración';

const SECTIONS: NavigationSection[] = ['General', 'Servicio técnico', 'Abastecimiento', 'Administración'];

/** Los roles de cada módulo provienen de ROUTE_ROLES (mismo origen que App.tsx). */
export const navigationItems: NavigationItem[] = [
  { label: 'Dashboard', path: '/dashboard', icon: LayoutDashboard, roles: ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO', 'BODEGUERO', 'CONTADOR', 'PROVEEDOR'], section: 'General' },
  { label: 'Mi vehículo', path: '/dashboard#vehicles', icon: LayoutDashboard, roles: ['CLIENTE'], section: 'General' },
  { label: 'Órdenes de trabajo', path: '/ordenes-trabajo', icon: ClipboardList, roles: ROUTE_ROLES['ordenes-trabajo'], section: 'Servicio técnico' },
  { label: 'Vehículos', path: '/vehiculos', icon: Car, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.vehiculos, section: 'Servicio técnico' },
  { label: 'Citas', path: '/citas', icon: CalendarDays, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.citas, section: 'Servicio técnico' },
  { label: 'Inventario', path: '/inventory', icon: Package, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.inventory, section: 'Abastecimiento' },
  { label: 'Proveedores', path: '/proveedores', icon: Truck, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.proveedores, section: 'Abastecimiento' },
  { label: 'Compras', path: '/compras', icon: ShoppingCart, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.compras, section: 'Abastecimiento' },
  { label: 'Facturación', path: '/facturacion', icon: Receipt, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.facturacion, section: 'Administración' },
  { label: 'Pedidos recibidos', path: '/portal-proveedor', icon: Truck, roles: ROUTE_ROLES['portal-proveedor'], section: 'Abastecimiento' },
  { label: 'Usuarios', path: '/usuarios', icon: Users, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.usuarios, section: 'Administración' },
  { label: 'Historial de búsquedas', path: '/logs', icon: History, roles: ROUTE_ROLES.logs, section: 'Administración' },
];

/** Ítem de menú que corresponde a una ruta (para el título del encabezado). */
export function findNavigationItem(pathname: string): NavigationItem | undefined {
  return navigationItems.find((item) => item.path.split('#')[0] === pathname);
}

/** Iniciales para el avatar (máx. 2 letras). */
export function initials(name: string | undefined): string {
  if (!name) return '?';
  return name
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0]?.toUpperCase() ?? '')
    .join('');
}

interface SidebarProps {
  /** Solo aplica en móvil (< md); en escritorio el sidebar siempre está visible. */
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const navLinkClass = ({ isActive }: { isActive: boolean }) =>
  `group relative flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-200 ${
    isActive
      ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-500/20 to-brand-500/5 text-white shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_rgba(251,146,60,0.25)]'
      : 'text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white'
  }`;

export default function Sidebar({ isOpen, onClose }: SidebarProps) {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const visibleItems = user ? navigationItems.filter((item) => item.roles.includes(user.role)) : [];

  return (
    <>
      {isOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-30 md:hidden glass-overlay" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      )}

      <aside
        aria-label="Navegación principal"
        className={`glass-strong fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-40 flex w-72 flex-col transition-transform duration-300 md:static md:z-20 md:m-3 md:w-64 md:translate-x-0 md:rounded-2xl ${
          isOpen ? 'translate-x-0' : '-translate-x-full'
        }`}
      >
        <div className="flex h-16 items-center gap-3 border-b border-white/10 px-5">
          <div className="icon-badge flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center">
            <Wrench size={18} />
          </div>
          <div className="leading-tight">
            <span className="block text-lg font-bold tracking-tight text-white">GearTrace</span>
            <span className="block text-[11px] text-slate-500">Taller inteligente</span>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Cerrar menú"
            className="ml-auto rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white md:hidden"
          >
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <nav className="flex-1 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto px-3 py-4">
          {SECTIONS.map((section) => {
            const items = visibleItems.filter((item) => item.section === section);
            if (items.length === 0) return null;
            return (
              <div key={section}>
                <p className="mb-1.5 px-3 text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                  {section}
                </p>
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  {items.map(({ label, path, icon: Icon }) => (
                    <NavLink key={label} to={path} className={navLinkClass} end={path === '/dashboard'} onClick={onClose}>
                      {({ isActive }) => (
                        <>
                          <span
                            className={`absolute left-0 top-1/2 h-5 w-1 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-r-full bg-brand-400 transition-opacity ${
                              isActive ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'
                            }`}
                            aria-hidden="true"
                          />
                          <Icon
                            size={18}
                            className={isActive ? 'text-brand-300' : 'text-slate-500 transition-colors group-hover:text-slate-300'}
                          />
                          {label}
                        </>
                      )}
                    </NavLink>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        <div className="border-t border-white/10 p-3">
          <div className="glass-inset flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl p-3">
            <div className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-400 to-brand-600 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {initials(user?.name)}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-white">{user?.name}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-brand-300">{user ? ROLE_META[user.role].label : ''}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={logout}
              title="Cerrar sesión"
              aria-label="Cerrar sesión"
              className="rounded-lg p-2 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-red-500/10 hover:text-red-400"
            >
              <LogOut size={18} />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </aside>
    </>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/pages/CitasPage.tsx
================
import { CalendarCheck, CalendarDays, ClipboardPlus } from 'lucide-react';
import { appointmentActionsApi, appointmentsApi, clientApi, vehiclesApi } from '../api/resources';
import type { Appointment, AppointmentStatus, Vehicle } from '../api/types';
import type { Column } from '../components/ui/DataTable';
import type { FormField, FormValues, SelectOption } from '../components/ui/ResourceFormModal';
import ResourceListPage, {
  CreateFormConfig,
  EditFormConfig,
  ResourceRowAction,
} from '../components/ui/ResourceListPage';
import StatusBadge from '../components/ui/StatusBadge';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { EMPTY, formatDateTime } from '../utils/format';
import { fromDateTimeLocal, optionalText, requiredNumber, text, toDateTimeLocal, toOptions } from '../utils/formValues';
import { APPOINTMENT_STATUS, WORK_ORDER_STATUS } from '../utils/status';

const OPEN_STATUSES: AppointmentStatus[] = ['AGENDADA', 'CONFIRMADA'];
const isOpen = (appointment: Appointment) => OPEN_STATUSES.includes(appointment.status);

const baseColumns: Column<Appointment>[] = [
  {
    key: 'scheduledAt',
    header: 'Fecha',
    render: (appointment) => (
      <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-slate-200">{formatDateTime(appointment.scheduledAt)}</span>
    ),
  },
  {
    key: 'vehicle',
    header: 'Vehículo',
    render: (appointment) =>
      appointment.vehicle ? (
        <div>
          <div className="font-mono text-slate-200">{appointment.vehicle.plate}</div>
          <div className="text-xs text-slate-500">
            {appointment.vehicle.make} {appointment.vehicle.model}
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        EMPTY
      ),
  },
  {
    key: 'reason',
    header: 'Motivo',
    hideOnMobile: true,
    render: (appointment) => appointment.reason ?? EMPTY,
  },
  {
    key: 'status',
    header: 'Estado',
    render: (appointment) => <StatusBadge {...APPOINTMENT_STATUS[appointment.status]} />,
  },
  {
    key: 'workOrder',
    header: 'Orden',
    hideOnMobile: true,
    render: (appointment) =>
      appointment.workOrder ? (
        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-semibold text-white">{appointment.workOrder.number}</span>
          <StatusBadge {...WORK_ORDER_STATUS[appointment.workOrder.status]} />
        </span>
      ) : (
        EMPTY
      ),
  },
];

const ownerColumn: Column<Appointment> = {
  key: 'owner',
  header: 'Cliente',
  hideOnMobile: true,
  render: (appointment) => appointment.vehicle?.owner?.name ?? EMPTY,
};

const staffColumns: Column<Appointment>[] = [...baseColumns.slice(0, 2), ownerColumn, ...baseColumns.slice(2)];

const vehicleLabel = (vehicle: Vehicle) =>
  `${vehicle.plate} · ${vehicle.make} ${vehicle.model}${vehicle.owner ? ` — ${vehicle.owner.name}` : ''}`;

function appointmentFields(loadVehicles: () => Promise<SelectOption[]>): FormField[] {
  return [
    { name: 'vehicleId', label: 'Vehículo', type: 'select', required: true, loadOptions: loadVehicles, wide: true },
    { name: 'scheduledAt', label: 'Fecha y hora', type: 'datetime', required: true, help: 'Debe ser una fecha futura.' },
    { name: 'reason', label: 'Motivo', type: 'textarea', maxLength: 255 },
  ];
}

const emptyAppointment: FormValues = { vehicleId: '', scheduledAt: '', reason: '' };

const appointmentPayload = (values: FormValues) => ({
  vehicleId: requiredNumber(values, 'vehicleId', 'Vehículo'),
  scheduledAt: fromDateTimeLocal(text(values, 'scheduledAt')),
  reason: optionalText(values, 'reason'),
});

const staffCreateForm: CreateFormConfig = {
  title: 'Agendar cita',
  fields: appointmentFields(async () => toOptions(await vehiclesApi.list(), (vehicle) => vehicle.id, vehicleLabel)),
  initialValues: emptyAppointment,
  submit: (values) => appointmentsApi.create(appointmentPayload(values)),
  successMessage: 'Cita agendada.',
};

const clientCreateForm: CreateFormConfig = {
  title: 'Solicitar cita',
  fields: appointmentFields(async () => toOptions(await clientApi.myVehicles(), (vehicle) => vehicle.id, vehicleLabel)),
  initialValues: emptyAppointment,
  submit: (values) => clientApi.createAppointment(appointmentPayload(values)),
  successMessage: 'Cita solicitada. El taller la confirmará.',
};

/** La cita se completa al generar su OT; aquí solo se agenda, confirma o cancela. */
const EDITABLE_STATUSES: AppointmentStatus[] = ['AGENDADA', 'CONFIRMADA', 'CANCELADA'];
const editableStatusOptions: SelectOption[] = EDITABLE_STATUSES.map((status) => ({
  value: status,
  label: APPOINTMENT_STATUS[status].label,
}));

const staffEditForm: EditFormConfig<Appointment> = {
  title: (appointment) => `Editar cita del ${formatDateTime(appointment.scheduledAt)}`,
  fields: () => [
    { name: 'scheduledAt', label: 'Fecha y hora', type: 'datetime', required: true },
    { name: 'status', label: 'Estado', type: 'select', required: true, options: editableStatusOptions },
    { name: 'reason', label: 'Motivo', type: 'textarea', maxLength: 255 },
  ],
  initialValues: (appointment) => ({
    scheduledAt: toDateTimeLocal(appointment.scheduledAt),
    status: appointment.status,
    reason: appointment.reason ?? '',
  }),
  submit: (appointment, values) => {
    const scheduledAt = text(values, 'scheduledAt');
    const status = EDITABLE_STATUSES.find((option) => option === text(values, 'status'));
    return appointmentsApi.update(appointment.id, {
      // Solo se envía si cambió: el backend exige fecha futura al reprogramar.
      scheduledAt: scheduledAt !== toDateTimeLocal(appointment.scheduledAt) ? fromDateTimeLocal(scheduledAt) : undefined,
      status,
      reason: optionalText(values, 'reason'),
    });
  },
  isEditable: isOpen,
};

function staffRowActions(appointment: Appointment): ResourceRowAction[] {
  if (!isOpen(appointment) || appointment.workOrder) return [];
  const actions: ResourceRowAction[] = [
    {
      key: 'work-order',
      label: 'Generar orden de trabajo',
      shortLabel: 'Generar OT',
      icon: ClipboardPlus,
      confirm: `¿Generar la orden de trabajo para ${appointment.vehicle?.plate ?? 'esta cita'}? La cita quedará completada.`,
      run: async () => {
        const order = await appointmentActionsApi.createWorkOrder(appointment.id);
        return `Orden ${order.number} creada desde la cita.`;
      },
    },
  ];
  if (appointment.status === 'AGENDADA') {
    actions.unshift({
      key: 'confirm',
      label: 'Confirmar cita',
      shortLabel: 'Confirmar',
      icon: CalendarCheck,
      tone: 'success',
      run: async () => {
        await appointmentsApi.update(appointment.id, { status: 'CONFIRMADA' });
        return 'Cita confirmada.';
      },
    });
  }
  return actions;
}

/**
 * /citas — GERENTE y MECANICO gestionan la agenda (/api/appointments) y
 * generan la OT desde la cita; el CLIENTE ve y solicita sus citas
 * (/api/client/appointments).
 */
export default function CitasPage() {
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const isClient = user?.role === 'CLIENTE';

  return (
    <ResourceListPage
      title={isClient ? 'Mis citas' : 'Agenda de citas'}
      description={isClient ? 'Citas solicitadas para tus vehículos' : 'Citas programadas en el taller'}
      icon={CalendarDays}
      entityLabel="la cita"
      fetchAll={isClient ? clientApi.myAppointments : appointmentsApi.list}
      columns={isClient ? baseColumns : staffColumns}
      emptyMessage={isClient ? 'Aún no has solicitado citas.' : 'No hay citas programadas.'}
      getRowLabel={(appointment) => formatDateTime(appointment.scheduledAt)}
      createForm={isClient ? clientCreateForm : staffCreateForm}
      editForm={isClient ? undefined : staffEditForm}
      rowActions={isClient ? undefined : staffRowActions}
      onDelete={user?.role === 'GERENTE' ? appointmentsApi.remove : undefined}
    />
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/pages/ComprasPage.tsx
================
import { Ban, PackageCheck, ShoppingCart } from 'lucide-react';
import { inventoryApi, inventoryFlowsApi, purchasesApi, suppliersApi } from '../api/resources';
import type { PurchaseOrder } from '../api/types';
import type { Column } from '../components/ui/DataTable';
import ResourceListPage, {
  CreateFormConfig,
  EditFormConfig,
  ResourceRowAction,
} from '../components/ui/ResourceListPage';
import { idValue, optionalNumber, requiredNumber, toOptions } from '../utils/formValues';
import StatusBadge from '../components/ui/StatusBadge';
import { EMPTY, formatCurrency, formatDate } from '../utils/format';
import { PURCHASE_STATUS } from '../utils/status';

/** Total estimado a partir de los ítems con precio unitario. */
function estimatedTotal(order: PurchaseOrder): number | null {
  const priced = order.items?.filter((item) => item.unitPrice !== null) ?? [];
  if (priced.length === 0) return null;
  return priced.reduce((sum, item) => sum + Number(item.unitPrice) * item.quantity, 0);
}

const columns: Column<PurchaseOrder>[] = [
  { key: 'number', header: 'Pedido', render: (order) => <span className="font-semibold text-white">{order.number}</span> },
  { key: 'supplier', header: 'Proveedor', render: (order) => order.supplier?.name ?? EMPTY },
  {
    key: 'items',
    header: 'Ítems',
    hideOnMobile: true,
    render: (order) => {
      const items = order.items ?? [];
      const units = items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.quantity, 0);
      return `${items.length} piezas · ${units} u.`;
    },
  },
  {
    key: 'total',
    header: 'Total est.',
    hideOnMobile: true,
    align: 'right',
    render: (order) => formatCurrency(estimatedTotal(order)),
  },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Estado', render: (order) => <StatusBadge {...PURCHASE_STATUS[order.status]} /> },
  { key: 'orderedAt', header: 'Fecha', hideOnMobile: true, render: (order) => formatDate(order.orderedAt) },
];

const loadSupplierOptions = async () =>
  toOptions(await suppliersApi.list(), (supplier) => supplier.id, (supplier) => supplier.name);

/** El backend solo admite pedidos de piezas en o bajo su stock mínimo. */
const loadLowStockOptions = async () =>
  toOptions(
    await inventoryApi.lowStockParts(),
    (part) => part.id,
    (part) => `${part.name} (${part.code}) · stock ${part.quantity} / mín. ${part.minStock}`,
  );

const createForm: CreateFormConfig = {
  title: 'Nueva orden de compra',
  fields: [
    { name: 'supplierId', label: 'Proveedor', type: 'select', required: true, loadOptions: loadSupplierOptions, wide: true },
    {
      name: 'partId',
      label: 'Repuesto',
      type: 'select',
      required: true,
      loadOptions: loadLowStockOptions,
      wide: true,
      placeholder: 'Selecciona una pieza con stock bajo',
      help: 'Solo aparecen piezas en o bajo su stock mínimo. El código OC-AAAA-NNN se asigna automáticamente.',
    },
    { name: 'quantity', label: 'Cantidad', type: 'number', required: true, min: 1, step: '1' },
    { name: 'unitPrice', label: 'Precio unitario', type: 'number', min: 0, step: '0.01' },
  ],
  initialValues: { supplierId: '', partId: '', quantity: '1', unitPrice: '' },
  submit: (values) =>
    purchasesApi.create({
      supplierId: requiredNumber(values, 'supplierId', 'Proveedor'),
      items: [
        {
          partId: requiredNumber(values, 'partId', 'Repuesto'),
          quantity: requiredNumber(values, 'quantity', 'Cantidad'),
          unitPrice: optionalNumber(values, 'unitPrice', 'Precio unitario'),
        },
      ],
    }),
  successMessage: 'Orden de compra creada.',
};

const isPending = (order: PurchaseOrder) => order.status === 'PENDIENTE';

const editForm: EditFormConfig<PurchaseOrder> = {
  title: (order) => `Editar ${order.number}`,
  fields: () => [
    { name: 'supplierId', label: 'Proveedor', type: 'select', required: true, loadOptions: loadSupplierOptions, wide: true },
  ],
  initialValues: (order) => ({ supplierId: idValue(order.supplierId) }),
  submit: (order, values) =>
    purchasesApi.update(order.id, { supplierId: requiredNumber(values, 'supplierId', 'Proveedor') }),
  isEditable: isPending,
};

function rowActions(order: PurchaseOrder): ResourceRowAction[] {
  if (!isPending(order)) return [];
  return [
    {
      key: 'receive',
      label: 'Recibir pedido (suma al inventario)',
      shortLabel: 'Recibir',
      icon: PackageCheck,
      tone: 'success',
      confirm: `¿Confirmas la recepción de ${order.number}? Se sumarán las cantidades al inventario.`,
      run: async () => {
        await inventoryFlowsApi.receivePurchase(order.id);
        return `Pedido ${order.number} recibido; inventario actualizado.`;
      },
    },
    {
      key: 'cancel',
      label: 'Cancelar pedido',
      shortLabel: 'Cancelar',
      icon: Ban,
      tone: 'danger',
      confirm: `¿Cancelar el pedido ${order.number}?`,
      run: async () => {
        await purchasesApi.update(order.id, { status: 'CANCELADA' });
        return `Pedido ${order.number} cancelado.`;
      },
    },
  ];
}

/** /compras — solo GERENTE. Recibir un pedido es la única vía que suma stock. */
export default function ComprasPage() {
  return (
    <ResourceListPage
      title="Compras"
      description="Órdenes de compra a proveedores"
      icon={ShoppingCart}
      entityLabel="el pedido"
      fetchAll={purchasesApi.list}
      columns={columns}
      emptyMessage="No hay órdenes de compra registradas."
      getRowLabel={(order) => order.number}
      onDelete={purchasesApi.remove}
      createForm={createForm}
      editForm={editForm}
      rowActions={rowActions}
    />
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ShieldCheck, Table2, Users } from 'lucide-react';
import { usersApi } from '../api/resources';
import type { AppUser } from '../api/types';
import type { Role } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import type { FormField, FormValues, SelectOption } from '../components/ui/ResourceFormModal';
import type { CreateFormConfig, EditFormConfig } from '../components/ui/ResourceListPage';
import { UserInputError } from '../api/errors';
import { optionalText, text } from '../utils/formValues';
import UsersList from '../components/Users/UsersList';
import type { Column } from '../components/ui/DataTable';
import ResourceListPage from '../components/ui/ResourceListPage';
import StatusBadge from '../components/ui/StatusBadge';
import ViewTabs, { ViewTab } from '../components/ui/ViewTabs';
import { formatDate } from '../utils/format';
import { ROLE_META } from '../utils/status';

type View = 'list' | 'access';

const tabs: ViewTab<View>[] = [
  { key: 'list', label: 'Listado', icon: Table2 },
  { key: 'access', label: 'Gestión de accesos', icon: ShieldCheck },
];

const columns: Column<AppUser>[] = [
  {
    key: 'name',
    header: 'Usuario',
    render: (user) => (
      <div>
        <div className="font-medium text-white">{user.name}</div>
        <div className="text-xs text-slate-400">{user.email}</div>
      </div>
    ),
  },
  {
    key: 'role',
    header: 'Rol',
    render: (user) => <StatusBadge {...ROLE_META[user.role]} />,
  },
  {
    key: 'status',
    header: 'Estado',
    render: (user) =>
      user.isActive ? (
        <StatusBadge label="Activo" tone="success" />
      ) : (
        <StatusBadge label="Inactivo" tone="neutral" />
      ),
  },
  { key: 'createdAt', header: 'Alta', hideOnMobile: true, render: (user) => formatDate(user.createdAt) },
];

const roleOptions: SelectOption[] = (Object.keys(ROLE_META) as Role[]).map((role) => ({
  value: role,
  label: ROLE_META[role].label,
}));

function userFields(mode: 'create' | 'edit'): FormField[] {
  return [
    { name: 'name', label: 'Nombre completo', type: 'text', required: true, maxLength: 150 },
    { name: 'email', label: 'Correo electrónico', type: 'email', required: true, maxLength: 255 },
    {
      name: 'password',
      label: 'Contraseña',
      type: 'password',
      required: mode === 'create',
      maxLength: 72,
      help: mode === 'create' ? 'Mínimo 6 caracteres.' : 'Déjala vacía para no cambiarla.',
    },
    { name: 'role', label: 'Rol', type: 'select', required: true, options: roleOptions },
    { name: 'isActive', label: 'Usuario activo (puede iniciar sesión)', type: 'checkbox', wide: true },
  ];
}

function isRole(value: string): value is Role {
  return value in ROLE_META;
}

function userPayload(values: FormValues) {
  const role = text(values, 'role');
  if (!isRole(role)) throw new UserInputError('Selecciona un rol válido.');
  return { name: text(values, 'name'), email: text(values, 'email'), role, isActive: values.isActive === true };
}

const createForm: CreateFormConfig = {
  title: 'Nuevo usuario',
  fields: userFields('create'),
  initialValues: { name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'CLIENTE', isActive: true },
  submit: (values) => usersApi.create({ ...userPayload(values), password: text(values, 'password') }),
  successMessage: 'Usuario creado.',
};

const editForm: EditFormConfig<AppUser> = {
  title: (user) => `Editar ${user.name}`,
  fields: () => userFields('edit'),
  initialValues: (user) => ({ name: user.name, email: user.email, password: '', role: user.role, isActive: user.isActive }),
  submit: (user, values) =>
    usersApi.update(user.id, { ...userPayload(values), password: optionalText(values, 'password') }),
};

/** /usuarios — solo GERENTE (protegida en App.tsx). */
export default function UsuariosPage() {
  const [view, setView] = useState<View>('list');
  const toolbar = <ViewTabs tabs={tabs} active={view} onChange={setView} />;

  if (view === 'access') {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {toolbar}
        <UsersList />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <ResourceListPage
      toolbar={toolbar}
      title="Usuarios"
      description="Personal del taller y clientes registrados"
      icon={Users}
      entityLabel="el usuario"
      fetchAll={usersApi.list}
      columns={columns}
      emptyMessage="No hay usuarios registrados."
      getRowLabel={(user) => user.email}
      onDelete={usersApi.remove}
      createForm={createForm}
      editForm={editForm}
    />
  );
}

import { Car } from 'lucide-react';

const columns: Column<Vehicle>[] = [
  {
    key: 'plate',
    header: 'Placa',
    render: (vehicle) => <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-white">{vehicle.plate}</span>,

];

    make: text(values, 'make'),
    model: text(values, 'model'),
    year: optionalNumber(values, 'year', 'Año'),
    color: optionalText(values, 'color'),
    vin: optionalText(values, 'vin'),
  };
}

const createForm: CreateFormConfig = {

    color: vehicle.color ?? '',
    vin: vehicle.vin ?? '',
  }),

};

================
File: frontend/src/routes/routeRoles.ts
================
import type { Role } from '../contexts/AuthContext';

/**
 * Fuente única de roles por ruta. La usan App.tsx (protección) y Sidebar.tsx
 * (visibilidad de enlaces), así un enlace nunca aparece para un rol que la
 * ruta rechazaría.
 */
export const ROUTE_ROLES = {
  inventory: ['GERENTE', 'BODEGUERO'],
  logs: ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO'],
  usuarios: ['GERENTE'],
  vehiculos: ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO'],
  'ordenes-trabajo': ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO'],
  citas: ['GERENTE', 'MECANICO', 'CLIENTE'],
  proveedores: ['GERENTE', 'BODEGUERO'],
  compras: ['GERENTE', 'BODEGUERO'],
  facturacion: ['GERENTE', 'CONTADOR'],
  'portal-proveedor': ['PROVEEDOR'],
} as const satisfies Record<string, readonly Role[]>;

export type AppRoute = keyof typeof ROUTE_ROLES;

export function canAccess(route: AppRoute, role: Role | undefined): boolean {
  return role !== undefined && (ROUTE_ROLES[route] as readonly Role[]).includes(role);
}

File: frontend/src/utils/status.ts
