import { PrismaClient, Role, WorkOrderStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import * as bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

const prisma = new PrismaClient();
const BCRYPT_ROUNDS = 10;

async function main() {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    throw new Error(
      'El seed de demostración está bloqueado en producción. Usa migraciones y crea usuarios con la API administrativa.',
    );
  }

  console.log('🌱 Iniciando seedeo de la base de datos...');

  // 1. Limpiar datos existentes (opcional, cuidado en producción)
  // await prisma.searchLog.deleteMany();
  // await prisma.part.deleteMany();
  // await prisma.box.deleteMany();
  // await prisma.user.deleteMany();

  // 2. Crear usuarios de demostración. SEED_PASSWORD permite cambiarla sin editar código.
  const seedPassword = process.env.SEED_PASSWORD?.trim() || 'password123';
  const defaultPassword = await bcrypt.hash(seedPassword, BCRYPT_ROUNDS);

  console.log('👤 Creando usuarios...');
  
  const gerente = await prisma.user.upsert({
    where: { email: 'gerente@geartrace.com' },
    update: { password: defaultPassword },
    create: {
      name: 'Gerente Principal',
      email: 'gerente@geartrace.com',
      password: defaultPassword,
      role: Role.GERENTE,
    },
  });

  const mecanico = await prisma.user.upsert({
    where: { email: 'mecanico@geartrace.com' },
    update: { password: defaultPassword },
    create: {
      name: 'Mecánico Jefe',
      email: 'mecanico@geartrace.com',
      password: defaultPassword,
      role: Role.MECANICO,
    },
  });

  const cliente = await prisma.user.upsert({
    where: { email: 'cliente@geartrace.com' },
    update: { password: defaultPassword },
    create: {
      name: 'Cliente Demo',
      email: 'cliente@geartrace.com',
      password: defaultPassword,
      role: Role.CLIENTE,
    },
  });

  console.log(`✅ Usuarios creados: ${gerente.email}, ${mecanico.email}, ${cliente.email}`);

  // 3. Crear vehículos de prueba
  console.log('🚗 Creando vehículos de prueba...');

  const vehiculoCliente = await prisma.vehicle.upsert({
    where: { plate: 'ABC-123' },
    update: { ownerId: cliente.id },
    create: {
      plate: 'ABC-123',
      make: 'Toyota',
      model: 'Corolla',
      year: 2020,
      color: 'Blanco',
      ownerId: cliente.id,
    },
  });

  const vehiculoEmpresa = await prisma.vehicle.upsert({
    where: { plate: 'GTR-456' },
    update: { ownerId: cliente.id },
    create: {
      plate: 'GTR-456',
      make: 'Chevrolet',
      model: 'D-Max',
      year: 2021,
      color: 'Gris',
      ownerId: cliente.id,
    },
  });

  // 4. Crear proveedor de prueba
  const proveedor = await prisma.supplier.upsert({
    where: { taxId: '0999999999001' },
    update: {},
    create: {
      name: 'Autopartes Andinas',
      taxId: '0999999999001',
      contactName: 'Laura Mera',
      email: 'ventas@autopartesandinas.com',
      phone: '0999999999',
    },
  });

  console.log(`✅ Vehículos y proveedor creados: ${vehiculoCliente.plate}, ${vehiculoEmpresa.plate}, ${proveedor.name}`);

  // 5. Crear Cajas (solo si no existen)
  console.log('📦 Creando cajas físicas...');
  
  const cajasData = [
    { name: 'Caja A - Filtros', ledIndex: 0, location: 'Estante 1, Nivel A', colorHex: '#FF4500' },
    { name: 'Caja B - Frenos', ledIndex: 1, location: 'Estante 1, Nivel B', colorHex: '#1E90FF' },
    { name: 'Caja C - Correas', ledIndex: 2, location: 'Estante 2, Nivel A', colorHex: '#32CD32' },
    { name: 'Caja D - Eléctrico', ledIndex: 3, location: 'Estante 2, Nivel B', colorHex: '#FFD700' },
    { name: 'Caja E - Lubricantes', ledIndex: 4, location: 'Estante 3, Nivel A', colorHex: '#9400D3' },
  ];

  for (const c of cajasData) {
    await prisma.box.upsert({
      where: { ledIndex: c.ledIndex },
      update: {},
      create: c,
    });
  }

  // 6. Crear Piezas
  console.log('⚙️ Creando inventario de piezas...');
  
  // Buscar caja 1 y 2 para relacionar
  const cajaA = await prisma.box.findUnique({ where: { ledIndex: 0 } });
  const cajaB = await prisma.box.findUnique({ where: { ledIndex: 1 } });

  if (cajaA && cajaB) {
    const filtroAceite = await prisma.part.upsert({
      where: { code: 'FLT-OIL-001' },
      update: {},
      create: {
        name: 'Filtro de aceite Toyota',
        code: 'FLT-OIL-001',
        unitPrice: 12.5,
        quantity: 15,
        minStock: 3,
        boxId: cajaA.id,
        keywords: ['filtro aceite', 'filtro toyota', 'filtro'],
      },
    });

    const pastillasFreno = await prisma.part.upsert({
      where: { code: 'BRK-PAD-001' },
      update: {},
      create: {
        name: 'Pastillas de freno Brembo',
        code: 'BRK-PAD-001',
        unitPrice: 35,
        quantity: 6,
        minStock: 2,
        boxId: cajaB.id,
        keywords: ['pastillas', 'frenos', 'pastillas freno'],
      },
    });

    await prisma.purchaseOrder.upsert({
      where: { number: 'PO-0001' },
      update: { supplierId: proveedor.id },
      create: {
        number: 'PO-0001',
        supplierId: proveedor.id,
        items: {
          create: [
            { partId: filtroAceite.id, quantity: 20, unitPrice: 8.5 },
            { partId: pastillasFreno.id, quantity: 10, unitPrice: 25 },
          ],
        },
      },
    });
  }

  // 7. Crear órdenes de trabajo ficticias
  // Mismo formato que genera WorkOrdersService (RF-SER-05): OT-YYYY-NNN
  const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  await prisma.workOrder.upsert({
    where: { number: `OT-${currentYear}-001` },
    update: {},
    create: {
      number: `OT-${currentYear}-001`,
      description: 'Cambio de aceite y filtro',
      status: WorkOrderStatus.CONCLUIDO,
      finalCost: 45,
      vehicleId: vehiculoCliente.id,
      mechanicId: mecanico.id,
      completedAt: new Date(),
    },
  });

  await prisma.workOrder.upsert({
    where: { number: `OT-${currentYear}-002` },
    update: {},
    create: {
      number: `OT-${currentYear}-002`,
      description: 'Revisión del sistema de frenos',
      status: WorkOrderStatus.EN_DIAGNOSTICO,
      vehicleId: vehiculoEmpresa.id,
      mechanicId: mecanico.id,
    },
  });

  console.log('🎉 ¡Seed finalizado exitosamente!');
}

main()
  .catch((e) => {
    console.error(e);
    process.exit(1);
  })
  .finally(async () => {
    await prisma.$disconnect();
  });

================
File: backend/src/led/led.gateway.ts
================
import { Logger, OnModuleDestroy } from '@nestjs/common';
import {
  ConnectedSocket,
  MessageBody,
  OnGatewayConnection,
  OnGatewayDisconnect,
  OnGatewayInit,
  SubscribeMessage,
  WebSocketGateway,
  WebSocketServer,
  WsException,
} from '@nestjs/websockets';
import { Subscription } from 'rxjs';
import { Server, Socket } from 'socket.io';
import { CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS, corsOriginCallback, isAllowedOrigin } from '../common/cors';
import { LedIndicatorService } from './led-indicator.service';
import { LedEvent, LedRequestError, SOCKET_EVENTS } from './led.types';

/** Mensaje que envía el dashboard (led:turnOff, led:test). */
interface LedMessage {
  ledIndex: number;
  colorHex?: string;
}

/** Valida la forma del mensaje del cliente; el rango y el color los valida el servicio. */
function parseLedMessage(data: unknown): LedMessage {
  if (typeof data !== 'object' || data === null) {
    throw new LedRequestError('Mensaje inválido: se espera { ledIndex, colorHex? }');
  }
  const ledIndex = 'ledIndex' in data ? data.ledIndex : undefined;
  const colorHex = 'colorHex' in data ? data.colorHex : undefined;
  if (typeof ledIndex !== 'number') {
    throw new LedRequestError('ledIndex debe ser un número');
  }
  if (colorHex !== undefined && typeof colorHex !== 'string') {
    throw new LedRequestError('colorHex debe ser un texto #RRGGBB');
  }
  return { ledIndex, colorHex };
}

/**
 * Transporte Socket.io del módulo de LEDs. Solo traduce:
 *  - mensajes del dashboard → llamadas a `LedIndicatorService`
 *  - eventos de `LedIndicatorService` → emisiones a los clientes
 * La lógica (parpadeo, auto-apagado) vive en el servicio.
 */
@WebSocketGateway({
  cors: {
    origin: corsOriginCallback,
    credentials: true,
    allowedHeaders: CORS_ALLOWED_HEADERS,
  },
  namespace: '/',
  // Solo WebSocket: el long-polling (XHR) a través de ngrok recibe la página
  // HTML de advertencia y rompe el handshake de Socket.io.
  transports: ['websocket'],
  // CORS no aplica al upgrade WebSocket: se valida el Origin explícitamente.
  allowRequest: (request, callback) => {
    const allowed = isAllowedOrigin(request.headers.origin);
    callback(allowed ? null : 'Origen WebSocket no permitido', allowed);
  },
})
export class LedGateway
  implements OnGatewayInit, OnGatewayConnection, OnGatewayDisconnect, OnModuleDestroy
{
  @WebSocketServer()
  server: Server;

  private readonly logger = new Logger(LedGateway.name);
  private subscription?: Subscription;

  constructor(private readonly indicator: LedIndicatorService) {}

  afterInit(): void {
    this.subscription = this.indicator.events$.subscribe((event) => this.broadcast(event));
    this.logger.log('Socket.io Gateway inicializado y escuchando');
  }

  onModuleDestroy(): void {
    this.subscription?.unsubscribe();
  }

  handleConnection(client: Socket): void {
    this.logger.log(`Cliente conectado: ${client.id}`);
    client.emit(SOCKET_EVENTS.HW_STATUS, this.indicator.getStatus());
  }

  handleDisconnect(client: Socket): void {
    this.logger.log(`Cliente desconectado: ${client.id}`);
  }

  /** El operador apaga un LED manualmente desde el dashboard. */
  @SubscribeMessage(SOCKET_EVENTS.LED_TURN_OFF)
  handleManualOff(@MessageBody() data: unknown, @ConnectedSocket() client: Socket): void {
    try {
      const { ledIndex } = parseLedMessage(data);
      this.logger.log(`Apagado manual solicitado por ${client.id} → LED ${ledIndex}`);
      this.indicator.turnOff(ledIndex);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      throw this.toClientError(error);
    }
  }

  /** El operador prueba un LED desde el dashboard. */
  @SubscribeMessage(SOCKET_EVENTS.LED_TEST)
  async handleLedTest(@MessageBody() data: unknown, @ConnectedSocket() client: Socket): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const { ledIndex, colorHex } = parseLedMessage(data);
      this.logger.log(`Test de LED solicitado por ${client.id} → índice ${ledIndex}`);
      await this.indicator.test(ledIndex, colorHex);
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      throw this.toClientError(error);
    }
  }

  private broadcast(event: LedEvent): void {
    if (event.type === 'activated') {
      this.server.emit(SOCKET_EVENTS.LED_ACTIVATED, event.payload);
      return;
    }
    // Forma histórica del payload: { ledIndex, manual: true } | { ledIndex, auto: true }
    this.server.emit(SOCKET_EVENTS.LED_OFF, { ledIndex: event.ledIndex, [event.reason]: true });
  }

  /** Una petición inválida del cliente llega como evento `exception` con su mensaje, no como error interno. */
  private toClientError(error: unknown): unknown {
    return error instanceof LedRequestError ? new WsException(error.message) : error;
  }
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { LayoutDashboard, Menu } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../contexts/AuthContext';
import { ROLE_META } from '../utils/status';
import Sidebar, { findNavigationItem, initials } from './Sidebar';

export default function Layout() {
  const [isSidebarOpen, setIsSidebarOpen] = useState(false);
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const { user } = useAuth();

  // Título del encabezado según la sección actual del menú.
  const current = findNavigationItem(pathname);
  const SectionIcon = current?.icon ?? LayoutDashboard;

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen overflow-hidden text-slate-100">
      <Sidebar isOpen={isSidebarOpen} onClose={() => setIsSidebarOpen(false)} />

      <main className="relative flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col overflow-hidden">
        <header className="glass z-10 mx-3 mt-3 flex h-16 items-center gap-3 rounded-2xl px-4 sm:px-6 md:ml-0">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setIsSidebarOpen(true)}
            aria-label="Abrir menú"
            className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:bg-white/5 hover:text-white md:hidden"
          >
            <Menu size={22} />
          </button>

          <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3">
            <SectionIcon size={20} className="hidden shrink-0 text-brand-300 sm:block" />
            <div className="min-w-0 leading-tight">
              <p className="hidden text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 sm:block">
                {current?.section ?? 'GearTrace'}
              </p>
              <h1 className="truncate text-lg font-semibold text-white">{current?.label ?? 'Panel de control'}</h1>
            </div>
          </div>

          {user && (
            <div className="ml-auto hidden items-center gap-3 sm:flex">
              <div className="text-right leading-tight">
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-white">{user.name}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{ROLE_META[user.role].label}</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-brand-400 to-brand-600 text-sm font-bold text-white ring-2 ring-white/10">
                {initials(user.name)}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </header>

        <div className="z-0 flex-1 overflow-auto p-3 sm:p-6 md:pl-3">
          <Outlet />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

================
File: frontend/src/App.tsx
================
import { ReactNode } from 'react'
import { Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { useAuth } from './contexts/AuthContext'
import Login from './components/Login'
import Dashboard from './components/Dashboard'
import Layout from './components/Layout'
import InventoryList from './components/Inventory/InventoryList'
import AuditLogs from './components/AuditLogs'
import RoleProtectedRoute from './components/RoleProtectedRoute'
import UsuariosPage from './pages/UsuariosPage'
import VehiculosPage from './pages/VehiculosPage'
import OrdenesTrabajoPage from './pages/OrdenesTrabajoPage'
import CitasPage from './pages/CitasPage'
import ProveedoresPage from './pages/ProveedoresPage'
import ComprasPage from './pages/ComprasPage'
import FacturacionPage from './pages/FacturacionPage'
import ProveedorPortalPage from './pages/ProveedorPortalPage'
import { AppRoute, ROUTE_ROLES } from './routes/routeRoles'

/** Vista de cada ruta protegida; los roles salen de ROUTE_ROLES. */
const protectedRoutes: Record<AppRoute, ReactNode> = {
  inventory: <InventoryList />,
  logs: <AuditLogs />,
  // Administración
  usuarios: <UsuariosPage />,
  // Servicios (SER)
  vehiculos: <VehiculosPage />,
  'ordenes-trabajo': <OrdenesTrabajoPage />,
  citas: <CitasPage />,
  // Abastecimiento (ABA)
  proveedores: <ProveedoresPage />,
  compras: <ComprasPage />,
  // Facturación (FIN)
  facturacion: <FacturacionPage />,
  'portal-proveedor': <ProveedorPortalPage />,
}

/** Rutas anteriores en inglés: redirigen a la ruta canónica en español. */
const legacyRedirects: Record<string, string> = {
  users: '/usuarios',
  'work-orders': '/ordenes-trabajo',
  suppliers: '/proveedores',
  billing: '/facturacion',
}

function App() {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useAuth()

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-t-2 border-b-2 border-brand-500"></div>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route
        path="/login"
        element={!isAuthenticated ? <Login /> : <Navigate to="/dashboard" />}
      />

      <Route
        path="/"
        element={isAuthenticated ? <Layout /> : <Navigate to="/login" />}
      >
        <Route index element={<Navigate to="/dashboard" />} />
        <Route path="dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />

        {(Object.keys(protectedRoutes) as AppRoute[]).map((path) => (
          <Route
            key={path}
            path={path}
            element={
              <RoleProtectedRoute allowedRoles={[...ROUTE_ROLES[path]]}>
                {protectedRoutes[path]}
              </RoleProtectedRoute>
            }
          />
        ))}

        {Object.entries(legacyRedirects).map(([from, to]) => (
          <Route key={from} path={from} element={<Navigate to={to} replace />} />
        ))}
      </Route>

      <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to={isAuthenticated ? "/dashboard" : "/login"} />} />
    </Routes>
  )
}

export default App
